a: Halach gedol habbayit levet hakkevarot, mahu?
Ta shema, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: afillu halach gedol habbayit levet hakkevarot — mone immahen. mone immahen? vehatanya mone leatzmo!
La kashya: ha daata bego telata, veha dela ata bego telata. ki ha daamar lehu rav livne hatztzalboni: deatu bego telata — limno bahadayychu, dela atu bego telata — limno lenafshayhu.
Amar lehu rava livne machoza: attun dela azlitu batar arsa, mikki mehadderitu appayychu mibbava daavulla — atchilu meno.
Rabbi shimon omer: afillu ba bayyom hashshevii mimmakom karov — mone immahen. amar rabbi chiyyay bar gammada amar rabbi yose ben shaul amar rabbi: vehu shebba umatza menachamin etzlo.
Bae rav anan: ninaru laamod velo amdu, mahu? teku.

Gemiri chavreh derabbi abba bar chiyyay merabbi abba, umannu — rabbi zera, veamri la: chavreh derabbi zera merabbi zera, umannu — rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel bitrefot, vahalacha kerabbi shimon beevel.
Kerabbi shimon beevel — ha daamaran. kerabban shimon ben gamliel bitrefot — ditnan: bene meayim shennikkevu velecha sotamtan — keshera, divre rabban shimon ben gamliel.
May lecha? amar rav kahana: shirka dimayya denafek aggav ducheka. amar man dehu: izke veessak veegmera lishmata mippummeh demaray,
Ki selek, ashkecheh lerabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba. amar leh: amar mar: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel bitrefot? amar leh: ana "en halacha" amari.
Kerabbi shimon beevel, may? amar leh: pelugeta ninhu, deittemar, rav chisda amar: halacha, vechen amar rabbi yochanan: halacha. rav nachman amar: en halacha.
Veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel bitrefot, vahalacha kerabbi shimon beevel. deamar shemuel: halacha kedivre hammekel beevel.
Al kol hammetim kullan medache mittato — hare ze meshubbach. al aviv veal immo — hare ze megunne, haya erev shabbat o erev yom tov — hare ze meshubbach, sheeno ose ella lichvod aviv veimmo.
Al kol hammetim kullan, ratza — memaet beisko, ratza — eno
b: Memaet, al aviv veal immo — memaet.
Al kol hammetim kullan, ratza — choletz, ratza — eno choletz. al aviv veal immo — choletz.
Umaase bigdol haddor echad shemmet aviv uvikkesh lachlotz, uvikkesh gedol haddor acher sheimmo lachlotz, venimna velo chalatz.
Amar abbaye: gedol haddor — rabbi, gedol haddor sheimmo — rabbi yaakov bar acha. veikka deamri: gedol haddor — rabbi yaakov bar acha, gedol haddor sheimmo — rabbi.
Bishlama leman deamar gedol haddor sheimmo — rabbi, hayeynu denimna velo chalatz,
Ella leman deamar rabbi yaakov bar acha, ammay nimna velo chalatz? rabban shimon ben gamliel nasi hava, vechulle alma michayyeyvi lemichlatz! kashya.

Al kol hammetim kullan mistapper leachar sheloshim yom, al aviv veal immo — ad sheyyigaru bo chaverav. al kol hammetim kullan nichnas levet hassimcha leachar sheloshim yom, al aviv veal immo — leachar shenem asar chodesh.
Amar rabba bar bar chana: ulesimchat mereut. metivi: ulesimcha velimreut sheloshim yom. kashya.
Ammemar matne hachi, amar rabba bar bar chana: ulesimchat mereut muttar likkanes lealtar. veha tanya: lesimcha sheloshim, velimreut sheloshim!
La kashya: ha baarisuta, ha befureanuta.
Al kol hammetim kullan korea tefach, al aviv veal immo ad sheyyegalle et libbo. amar rabbi avahu, may kera: "vayyachazek david bivgadav vayyikraem", veen achiza pachot mittefach.
Al kol hammetim kullan afillu lavush asara chalukin — eno korea ella elyon, al aviv veal immo — korea et kullan. veappikarsuto enah meakkevet.
Echad haish veechad ishsha. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: haishsha koraat et hattachton umachzirato laachoreha, vechozeret vekoraat et haelyon.
Al kol hammetim kullan, ratza — mavdil kamme safa shello, ratza — eno mavdil. al aviv veal immo — mavdil.

Rabbi yehuda omer: kol keria sheeno mavdil kamme safa shello — eno ella kera shel tiflut. amar rabbi avahu: may tama derabbi yehuda, dichtiv: "vayyachazek bivgadav vayyikraem lishnayim keraim", mimmashma shenneemar "vayyikraem" eni yodea shehen lishnayim? ella shennirin keruim kishnayim.
Al kol hammetim kullan sholel leachar shiva, umeache leachar sheloshim. al aviv veal immo — sholel leachar sheloshim veeno meache leolam. vehaishsha sholalto lealtar mippene kevodah.
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: al kol hammetim, ratza — korea bayyad, ratza — korea bichli. al aviv veal immo — bayyad.
Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: al kol hammetim kullan — mibbifnim, al aviv veal immo — korea mibbachutz. amar rav chisda: vechen lannasi.
Metivi: lo hushevu leaviv uleimmo ella leichuy bilvad.
May lav, afillu lenasi? la, levar minnasi.
Nesia shechev, amar leh rav chisda lerav chanan bar rava: kefi asita vekum ala, veachvi keria lealma.
Al chacham choletz miyyamin, al av bet din missemol, al nasi mikkan umikkan.

Tanu rabbanan: chacham shemmet — bet midrasho batel, av bet din shemmet — kol batte midrashot shebbeiro betelin. venichnasin levet hakkeneset umeshannin et mekoman: hayyoshvin batztzafon — yoshvin baddarom, hayyoshvin baddarom — yoshvin batztzafon. nasi shemmet — batte midrashot kullan betelin, uvene hakkeneset nichnasin levet hakkeneset

a: Vekorin shiva, veyotzin. rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: lo sheyyelchu vitayyeylu bashshuk, ella yoshvin vedavivyn.
Veen omrim shemua veaggada bevet haevel. amru alav al rabbi chananya ben gamliel shehaya omer shemua veaggada bevet haevel.
Tanu rabbanan: avel, shabbat rishona — eno yotze mippetach beto, sheniyya — yotze veeno yoshev bimkomo, shelishit — yoshev bimkomo veeno medabber, reviit — hare hu kechol adam.

Rabbi yehuda omer: lo hutzerchu lomar shabbat rishona lo yetze mippetach beto, shehare hakkol nichnasin leveto lenachamo. ella: sheniyya — eno yotze mippetach beto, shelishit — yotze veeno yoshev bimkomo, reviit — yoshev bimkomo veeno medabber, chamishit — hare hu kechol adam.
Tanu rabbanan: kol sheloshim yom lannissuin. meta ishto — asur lissa ishsha acheret ad sheyyaavru alav shelosha regalim. rabbi yehuda omer: regel rishon vesheni — asur, shelishi — muttar.
Veim en lo banim — muttar lissa lealtar mishshum bittul periyya ureviyya. hinnicha lo banim ketannim — muttar lissa lealtar mippene farnasatan.

Maase shemmeta ishto shel yosef hakkohen, veamar laachotah bevet hakkevarot: lechi ufarnesi et bene achotech, veaf al pi chen lo ba aleha ella lizman merubbe. may lizman merubbe? amar rav pappa: leachar sheloshim yom.

Tanu rabbanan: kol sheloshim yom legihutz, echad kelim chadashim veechad kelim yeshanim yotzin mittoch hammachbesh. rabbi omer: lo asru ella kelim chadashim bilvad. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: lo asru ella kelim chadashim levanim bilvad.
Abbaye nafek bigrada desarbala kerabbi. rava nafek bechimmutzeta romita summakta chadti kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon.
Mippene sheamru: shabbat ola veenah mafseket. bene yehuda uvene galila. hane amri:
b: Yesh avelut beshabbat, vehane amri: en avelut beshabbat.
Man deamar yesh avelut beshabbat, dekatane "ola". man deamar en avelut beshabbat, dekatane "enah mafseket".
I salka datach yesh avelut beshabbat, hasheta avelut nahaga, afsoke mibbaya?
Veella ha katane "ola"! ayyeyde dekavae lemitne sefa "enan olim", tena resha "ola".
Uleman deamar yesh avelut beshabbat, ha katane enah mafseket! mishshum dekavae lemitne sefa "mafsikin", tena resha "enah mafseket".

Lema ketannae: mi shemmeto muttal lefanav — ochel bevayit acher. en lo bayit acher — ochel bevet chavero, en lo bayit chavero — ose lo mechitza asara tefachim. en lo davar laasot mechitza — machzir panav veochel.

Veeno mesev veochel, veeno ochel basar veeno shote yayin, veen mevarech veen mezammen, veen mevarchin alav veen mezammenin alav, ufatur mikkeriat shema umin hattefilla umin hattefillin, umikkol mitzvot haamurot battora.

Uveshabbat — mesev veochel, veochel basar veshote yayin, umevarech umezammen, umevarchin umezammenin alav, vechayyayv bikriat shema uvitfilla uvitfillin, uvechol mitzvot haamurot battora. rabban gamliel omer: mittoch shennitchayyev beellu — nitchayyev bechullan.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: tashmish hammitta ikka benayyhu.
May lav beha ka mippalgi, demar savar: yesh avelut beshabbat, umar savar: en avelut beshabbat!
Mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar tanna kamma hatam, ella mishshum demeto muttal lefanav. aval hacha, deen meto muttal lefanav — la.
Vead kan la kaamar rabban gamliel hatam, deakkatti la chal avelut aleh. aval hacha, dechal avelut aleh — hachi name.

a: Bea minneh rabbi yochanan mishshemuel: yesh avelut beshabbat o en avelut beshabbat? amar leh: en avelut beshabbat.
Yatvi rabbanan kammeh derav pappa vekaamri mishshemeh dishmuel: avel sheshshimmesh mittato bime evlo — chayyayv mita. amar leh rav pappa: asur ittemar, umishshemeh derabbi yochanan ittemar,

Vei shemia lechu mishshemeh dishmuel, hachi shemia lechu: amar rav tachlifa bar avimi amar shemuel: avel shello pera veshello peram — chayyayv mita, shenneemar: "rashechem al tifrau uvigdechem lo tifromu velo tamutu vegomer", ha acher shello pera veshello peram — chayyayv mita.
Amar rafram bar pappa, tana beevel rabbati: avel asur leshammesh mittato bime evlo, umaase beechad sheshshimmesh mittato bime evlo, veshamtu chazirim et geviyyayto.
Amar shemuel: pachaz chova, neter reshut.
Periat harosh, chazarat kera laachorav, zekifat hammitta — chova. neilat hassandal, tashmish hammitta, rechitzat yadayim veraglayim bechammin arvit — reshut. verav amar: af periat harosh reshut.
Ushemuel, may shena neilat hassandal dirshut — delav kulle alma avidi desayymi mesanayyhu. periat harosh name, lav kulle alma avidi dimgallu reshayyhu!
Shemuel letameh, deamar shemuel: kol kera sheeno bishat chimmum — eno kera. vechol atifa sheenah kaatifat yishmeelim — enah atifa. machve rav nachman ad gubbe dedikna.
Amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella sheen lo minalim beraglav, aval yesh lo minalim beraglav — minalav mochichin alav.

Kol kera sheeno bishat chimmum eno kera — veha amaru leh lishmuel: nach nafsheh derav, kera aleh teresar mane. amar: azal gavra dahava mistefena minneh. amar leh lerabbi yochanan: nach nafsheh derabbi chanina. kera aleh telesar itztele melata. amar: azal gavra dahava mistefena minneh!
Shane rabbanan, dechevan dechol shata madkeri shematayyhu — kishat chimmum dame.

Amar leh ravin bar adda lerava: amar talmidcha rav amram, tanya: avel, kol shiva koro lefanav, veim ba lehachalif — machlif vekorea. beshabbat, koro laachorav, veim ba lehachalif — machlif veeno korea!
Ki tanya hahi, bichvod aviv veimmo.
Otan kerain mitachin, o en mitachin? peligi ba avu derav oshaya uvar kappara. chad amar: en mitachin, vechad amar: mitachin.
Tistayyem daavu derav oshaya deamar en mitachin. deamar rav oshaya: en mitachin, mimman shemia leh — lav meavu? la, mibbar kappara rabbeh shemia leh.

Amar rava: avel metayyel beunekli betoch beto. abbaye ashkecheh lerav yosef difris leh sudara aresheh veazel veate beveteh. amar leh: lav savar la mar en avelut beshabbat? amar leh, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: devarim shebbetzina — noheg.
Rabbi eliezer omer: mishshecharav bet hammikdash atzeret kashshabbat vechulei. amar rav giddel bar menashsheya amar shemuel: halacha kerabban gamliel.
Veikka dematne leha derav giddel bar menashsheya aha: kol sheloshim yom, tinok yotze bachek, venikbar beishsha achat ushene anashim. aval lo beish echad ushete nashim.
b: Abba shaul omer: af beish echad ushete nashim. veen omdin alav beshura. veen omrim alav birkat avelim vetanchume avelim.
Ben sheloshim yotze bidloskama. rabbi yehuda omer: lo deloskama hannittelet bakkatef, ella hannittelet baagappayim. veomdin alav beshura, veomrim alav birkat avelim vetanchume avelim.
Ben shenem asar chodesh yotze bemitta. rabbi akiva omer: hu ben shana veevarav keven shetayim, hu ben shetayim veevarav keven shana — yotze bemitta.

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: hayyotze bemitta — rabbim matzhivin alav. eno yotze bemitta — en rabbim matzhivin alav. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: nikkar larabbim — rabbim mitassekim immo, eno nikkar larabbim — en rabbim mitassekim immo.

Uma hen behesped? rabbi meir beshem rabbi yishmael omer: aniyyim — bene shalosh, ashirim — bene chamesh. rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo: aniyyim — bene chamesh, ashirim — bene shesh, uvene zekenim — kivne aniyyim.
Amar rav giddel bar menashsheya amar rav: halacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi yishmael.
Daresh rabbi anani bar sason appitcha deve nesia: yom echad lifne atzeret vaatzeret — hare kan arbaa asar. shema rabbi amme veikkefad, amar: attu dideh hi? derabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya hi!
Derash rabbi yitzchak nappacha akkila deresh galuta: yom echad lifne atzeret vaatzeret — hare kan arbaa asar. shema rav sheshet ikkefad, amar: attu dideh hi? derabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya hi!

Deamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: minnayin laatzeret sheyyesh lah tashlumin kol shiva — shenneemar: "bechag hammatztzot uvechag hashshavuot", ma chag hammatztzot yesh lah tashlumin kol shiva — af chag hashshavuot yesh lah tashlumin kol shiva.

Adbereh rav pappa lerav avya sava uderash: yom echad lifne rosh hashshana verosh hashshana — hare kan arbaa asar. amar ravina, hilkach: yom echad lifne hechag, vechag, ushemini shello — hare kan esrim veechad yom.

Ravina ikkela lesura difrat, amar leh rav chaviva missura difrat leravina: amar mar, yom echad lifne rosh hashshana verosh hashshana — hare kan arbaa asar? amar leh: ana, mistabbera kerabban gamliel hu deamena.
Mishna en korin velo choltzin veen mavrin ella kerovav shel met, veen mavrin ella al mitta zekufa.

a: Gemara vaafillu chacham? vehatanya: chacham shemmet — hakkol kerovav.
Hakkol kerovav salka datach?! ella: hakkol kikrovav: hakkol korin alav, vehakkol choltzin alav, vehakkol mavrin alav barchava! la tzericha, delav chacham hu.
Vei adam kasher hu — chayyove michayyayv lemikra. detanya: mippene ma banav uvenotav shel adam metim keshehen ketannim — kede sheyyivke veyitabbel al adam kasher.

Yivke veyitabbel?! ervona ka shakel minneh?! ella: mippene shello bacha vehitabbel al adam kasher. shekkol habboche umitabbel al adam kasher — mochalin lo al kol avonotav bishvil kavod sheasa lo! delav adam kasher hu.

I dekae hatam bishat yetziat neshama chayyove michayyayv! detanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: haomed al hammet bishat yetziat neshama — chayyayv likroa. lema ze dome — lesefer tora shennisraf, shechayyayv likroa!
Dela kae hatam bishat yetziat neshama.
Ki nach nafsheh derav safra, la kerau rabbanan aleh, amri: la gamrinan minneh. amar lehu abbaye: mi tanya "harav shemmet"? "chacham shemmet" tanya. veod: kol yoma shematateh befummin beve midresha.
Sevur: ma dahava hava. amar lehu abbaye, tenena: chacham, kol zeman sheoskin behesped — chayyayvin likroa. sevur lemikra lealtar, amar lehu abbaye, tanya: chacham kevodo behespedo.

Ki nach nafsheh derav huna, sevur leotove sefer tora appureyeh. amar lehu rav chisda: milleta divchayyeh la sevira leh, hasheta lekum leh lebad leh? deamar rav tachlifa: ana chazeteh lerav huna devae lemetav appureyeh, vahava mannach sefer tora aleh, vechaf kadda aara veotev sefer tora illaveh. alma kasavar: asur leshev al gabbe mitta shessefer tora munnach aleha.
La hava nafek pureya mibbava, sevur leshalshole derech gaggin. amar lehu rav chisda, ha gemirna minneh: chacham, kevodo derech petach.

Sevur leashnoye mippureya lefureya. amar lehu rav chisda, hachi gemirna minneh: chacham kevodo bemitta rishona. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: minnayin lechacham shekkevodo bemitta rishona, shenneemar: "vayyarkivu et aron haelohim el agala chadasha". perus bava veappeku.
Petach aleh rabbi abba: rauy haya rabbenu shettishre alav shechina, ella shebbavel garma lo.
Metiv rav nachman bar chisda, veamri la rav chanan bar chisda: "hayo haya devar Adonai el yechezkel ben buzi hakkohen beeretz kasdim"!
Tefach leh avu besandaleh, amar leh: lav amena lach la titrod alma? may "haya" — shehaya kevar.
Ki asseku lehatam, amaru leh lerabbi amme ulerabbi assi: rav huna ate. amaru: ki havenan hatam la hava lan ledalloye reshin minneh. hasheta atenan hacha — ata batrin?
Amaru leh: arono ba. rabbi amme verabbi assi nefuk, rabbi ila verabbi chanina la nefuk. ikka deamri: rabbi ila nefak, rabbi chanina la nefak.

Dinfak, may tameh? detanya: aron haover mimmakom lemakom — omdim alav beshura veomrim alav birkat avelim vetanchume avelim. dela nefak, may tama? detanya: aron haover mimmakom lemakom — en omdin alav beshura veen omrim alav birkat avelim vetanchume avelim.
Kashyayn ahadade! la kashya: kan — sheshshildo kayyemet, kan — besheen shildo kayyemet. verav huna shildo kayyemet hava? dela nefak, la sayyeymuha kammeh.
Amri: hecha naynnecheh? rav huna ribbetz tora beyisrael, verabbi chiyyay ribbetz tora beyisrael hava.

Man meayyel leh? amar lehu rav chagga: ana meayyelna leh, deokemteh letalmuday ki havena bar tamne sere shenin vela chaze li keri, umeshamma li(5) kammeh, vidai beovadeh, deyoma chad ithaficha leh retzua ditfillin vitev ala arbein taaniyyata.

Ayyeyleh, hava gane yehuda miyyammineh daavu vechizkiyya missemaleh. amar leh yehuda lechizkiyya: kum midduchetich, delav orach ara dekaem rav huna. bahade dekaem — kam bahadeh ammuda denura. chazyeh rav chagga, ibbeit, zakfeh laaroneh unefak ata. vehay dela ianash (onesh), mishshum dezakfeh laaroneh derav huna.
Ki nach nafsheh derav chisda, sevur leotove sefer tora appureyeh. amar lehu rabbi yitzchak: milleta dilrabbeh la sevira leh, anan nekum naaved leh?
Sevur dela lemishlal kirayyhu. amar lehu rabbi yitzchak bar amme: chacham, kevan shehechziru penehem meachore hammitta — shollin.
Ki nach nafsheh derabba bar huna verav hamenuna, assekunehu lehatam.
b: Ki meto aggishra, kamu gamle. amar lehu hahu tayyaya: may hay? amaru leh: rabbanan deka avdi yekara ahadade. mar amar: mar neul beresha, umar amar: mar neul beresha. amar: dina hu derabba bar huna leul beresha. chalef gamleh derabba bar huna, netur kakkeh veshinneh dehahu tayyaya.

Petach aleh hahu yanoka: geza yeshishim ala mibbavel, veimmo sefer milchamot, kaat vekippod hucheplu, lirot beshod vashever habba mishshinar. katzaf al olamo vechamas mimmennu nefashot, vesamach bahem kechalla chadasha. rochev aravot sas vesamach, bevo elav nefesh naki vetzaddik.
Ki nach nafsheh deravina, petach aleh hahu safdana: temarim haniu rosh al tzaddik kattamar, nasim lelot keyamim al mesim lelot keyamim.

Amar leh rav ashe levar kippok: hahu yoma may amrat? amar leh, amena: im baarazim nafla shalhevet, ma yaasu ezove kir. livyatan bechakka hoala, ma yaasu dege rekak. benachal shotef nafla chakka, ma yaasu me gevim.
Amar leh bar avin: chas veshalom dechakka veshalhevet betzaddike amena. umay amrat? amena: bechu laavelim velo laaveda, shehi limnucha veanu laanacha.
Chalash dateh alayyhu, veithafuch karayyhu. hahu yoma la ato leaspodeh. vehayeynu deamar rav ashe: la bar kippok chaletz, vela bar avin chaletz.
Rava, ki hava ata lediglat, amar leh levar avin: kum ema milleta. kae veamar: bau rov shelishit bemayim, zechor verachem. tainu meacharecha keishsha mibbalah, al taznichenu keot me mara.
(Chanin, yochanan, zera, abba, yaakov, yose, shemuel, chiyyay, menachem siman).

Rabbi chanin, chatneh deve nesia hava. la (ka) havo leh bene, bea rachame vahavo leh. hahu yoma dahava leh, nach nafsheh, petach aleh hahu safdana: simcha letuga nehpacha, sason veyagon nidbaku, beet simchato neenach, beet chaninato avad chanino. assiku leh chanin al shemeh.

Ki nach nafsheh derabbi yochanan, petach aleh rabbi yitzchak ben elazar: kashe hayyom leyisrael keyom bo hashshemesh batztzohorayim, dichtiv: "vehaya bayyom hahu veheveti hashshemesh batztzohorayim". veamar rabbi yochanan: ze yomo shel yoshiyyahu.

Ki nach nafsheh derabbi yochanan, yatev rabbi amme shiva usheloshim. amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba: rabbi amme daavad — legarmeh hu daavad, dehachi amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: afillu rabbo shellimmedo chochma — eno yoshev alav ella yom echad.
Ki nach nafsheh derabbi zera, petach aleh hahu safdana: eretz shinar hara veyalda, eretz tzevi giddela shaashueha. oy na lah amra rakkat, ki ibbeda keli chemdatah.

Ki nach nafsheh derabbi avahu, achitu ammude dekesari mayya. derabbi yose, shefau marzeve detzippori dema. derabbi yaakov, itchamiu kochve bimama. derabbi assi, iakaru kol ilanayya. derabbi chiyyay, nechitu kefe denura merkia. derabbi menachem berabbi yose, ishtao tzalmanayyay vahavo (lemachletzayyay).

Derabbi tanchum bar chiyyay, itkatztzatzu kol anderatayya. derabbi elyashiv, ichataru shivin machtarta binhardea. derav hamenuna, nechitu kefe devarda merkia. derabba verav yosef, neshuk kefe difrat ahadade. deabbaye verava, neshuk kefe dediglat ahadade. ki nach nafsheh derabbi mesharsheya, teun dikle shitze.
Tanu rabbanan:

a: Veellu kerain sheen mitachin: hakkorea al aviv veal immo, veal rabbo shellimmedo tora, veal nasi veal av bet din, veal shemuot haraot, veal birkat hashshem, veal sefer tora shennisraf, veal are yehuda veal hammikdash veal yerushalayim. vekorea al mikdash, umosif al yerushalayim.

Aviv veimmo verabbo shellimmedo tora menalan — dichtiv: "veelisha roe vehu metzaek avi avi rechev yisrael ufarashav". "avi avi" — ze aviv veimmo, "rechev yisrael ufarashav" — ze rabbo shellimmedo tora.
May mashma? kedimtargem rav yosef: rabbi rabbi detav lehon leyisrael bitzloteh mertikkin ufarashin.
Velo mitachin menalan — dichtiv: "vayyachazek bivgadav vayyikraem lishnayim keraim", mimmashma shenneemar "vayyikraem" eni yodea shellishnayim? ella melammed shekkeruim veomdim lishnayim leolam.
Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: eliyyahu chay hu? amar leh, kevan dichtiv: "velo raahu od", legabbe dideh kemet dame.

Nasi veav bet din ushemuot haraot menalan — dichtiv: "vayyachazek david bivgadav vayyikraem vegam kol haanashim asher itto. vayyispedu vayyivku vayyatzumu ad haarev al shaul veal yehonatan beno veal am Adonai veal bet yisrael ki naflu becharev".
"Shaul" — ze nasi, "yehonatan" — ze av bet din, "al am Adonai veal bet yisrael" — ellu shemuot haraot.
Amar leh rav bar shabba lerav kahana: veema ad dehavu kullehu! amar leh: "al" "al" hifsik hainyan.
Umi karinan ashshemuot haraot? veha amaru leh lishmuel: ketal shabbur malka teresar alfe yehudae bimzigat kesari, vela kera! lo amru ella berov tzibbur uchemaase shehaya.

Umi ketal shabbur malka yehudae? veha amar leh shabbur malka lishmuel: tete li dela ketali yehudi meolam! hatam inhu garmi lenafshayyhu, deamar rabbi amme: lekal yetere dimzigat kesari, peka shura deludekiyya.
Al birkat hashshem menalan? dichtiv: "vayyavo elyakim ben chilkiyya asher al habbayit veshevna hassofer veyoach ben asaf hammazkir el chizkiyyahu kerue vegadim".
Tanu rabbanan: echad hashshomea veechad hashshomea mippi hashshomea — chayyayv likroa. vehaedim enan chayyayvin likroa, shekkevar karu beshaa sheshshamu.
Beshaa sheshshamu may have? ha ka shami hasheta! la salka datach, dichtiv: "vayhi kishmoa hammelech chizkiyyahu vayyikra et begadav", hammelech kara vehem lo karu.
Velo mitachin menalan — atya "keria" "keria".
Sefer tora shennisraf menalan? dichtiv: "vayhi kikro yehudi shalosh delatot vearbaa veyikraeha betaar hassofer vehashelech el haesh asher el haach vegomer". may shalosh delatot vearbaa?

Amaru leh lihoyakim: katav yirmeya sefer kinot. amar lehu: ma ketiv beh? "echa yashva badad". amar lehu: ana malka. amar leh: "bacho tivke ballayla". ana malka. "galta yehuda meoni". ana malka. "darche tziyyon avelot". ana malka.

"Hayu tzareha lerosh". amar lehu: man amra? "ki Adonai hogah al rov peshaeha". miyyad kadar kol azkarot shebbah, userafan baesh. vehayeynu dichtiv: "velo fachadu velo karu et bigdehem", mikkelal divo lemikra.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: emar mishshum shemuot haraot. amar leh: shemuot raot behahi shata mi havo?!
Amar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna: haroe sefer tora shennikra — chayyayv likroa shete keriot: echad al haggevil veechad al hakketav, shenneemar: "achare serof hammelech et hammegilla veet haddevarim".
Rabbi abba verav huna bar chiyyay havu yatvi kammeh derabbi abba. bea leippannoye, shakleh letotefteh achateh abbe sadya. atay bat naamita bea lemivleeh.

Amar: hasheta ki chayyeyvan li shete keriot. amar leh: mena lach ha? veha bedidi hava ovada, vaatay lekammeh derav matna vela hava bideh. atay lekammeh derav yehuda, vaamar li, hachi amar shemuel: lo amru ella bizroa, uchemaase shehaya.
Are yehuda menalan — dichtiv: "vayyavou anashim mishshechem mishshilo umishshomron shemonim ish megulleche zakan ukerue vegadim umitgoddim umincha ulevona beyadam lehavi bet Adonai vegomer".

Amar rabbi chelbo amar ulla biraa amar rabbi elazar: haroe are yehuda bechurebanan, omer: "are kodshecha hayu midbar", vekorea. yerushalayim bechurebanah, omer: "tziyyon midbar hayata yerushalam shemama", vekorea. bet hammikdash bechurebano, omer: "bet kodshenu vetifartenu asher hillucha avotenu haya lisrefat esh vechol machamaddenu haya lechorba", vekorea.
Korea al mikdash, umosif al yerushalayim. ureminhu: echad hashshomea veechad haroe, kevan shehiggia letzofim — korea, vekorea al mikdash bifne atzmo veal yerushalayim bifne atzmah!
La kashya: ha defaga bammikdash beresha. ha defaga birushalayim beresha.
Tanu rabbanan: vechullan rashshain leshollan ulemollan uleloktan velaasotan kemin sullamot, aval lo leachotan.
Amar rav chisda:
b: Uveichuy alekkesanderi.
Tanu rabbanan: hakkorea mittoch hashshelal mittoch hammelal mittoch halleket, mittoch hassullamot — lo yatza. mittoch haichuy — yatza. amar rav chisda: uveichuy alekkesanderi.

Tanu rabbanan: rashshay lehofcho lematta uleachoto. rabbi shimon ben elazar oser leachoto, ucheshem shehammocher asur leachoto — kach hallokeach asur leachoto. ulefichach mocher tzarich lehodio lallokeach.
Tanu rabbanan: techillat keria — tefach, vetosefet — shalosh etzbaot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: techillat keria — shalosh etzbaot, vetosefet — kol shehu.
Amar ulla: halacha kerabbi meir bikria, vahalacha kerabbi yehuda betosefet. tanya name hachi, rabbi yose omer: techillat keria — tefach, vetosefet — kol shehu.
Tanu rabbanan: amru lo met aviv vekara, met beno vehosif, tachton — mitache, elyon — eno mitache.
Met beno vekara, met aviv vehosif, elyon — mitache, tachton — eno mitache.
Met aviv, met immo, met achiv, meta achoto — korea kera echad lechullan. rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: al kullan kera echad, al aviv veimmo kera echad, lefi sheen mosifin al kera aviv veimmo.
May tama? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lefi sheenan betosefet.
Amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira. umi amar shemuel hachi? vehaamar shemuel: halacha kedivre hammekel beevel! avelut lechud, keria lechud.
Ad hechan korea — ad tibburo, veyesh omrim: ad libbo. af al pi sheen reaya ledavar, zecher laddavar, shenneemar: "vekiru levavchem veal bigdechem".

Higgia letibburo — marchik shalosh etzbaot vekorea. nitmalle millefanav — machziro laachorav. nitmalle millemala — hofcho millematta. vehakkorea millematta umin hatztzedadin — lo yatza. ella shekkohen gadol porem millematta.
Peligu ba rav matna umar ukeva, vetarvayyhu mishshemeh daavu dishmuel velevi. chad amar: kol shiva korea, leachar shiva — mosif. vechad amar: kol sheloshim korea, leachar sheloshim — mosif.
Matkef la rabbi zera: man deamar kol shiva korea, ammay — delo nittan leshollo, ella ha deamar mar: haishsha sholalto lealtar, hacha name?!
Hatam mishshum kevod ishsha hu.
Man deamar kol sheloshim korea, ammay — delo nittan leachoto. ella leaviv uleimmo, delo nittan leachoto leolam, hachi name?!
Hatam mishshum kevod aviv veimmo hu.
Tanu rabbanan: hayyotze beveged karua lifne hammet — hare ze gozel et hammetim veet hachayyim.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, haomer lachavero: hasheileni chalukecha veelech vaavakker et abba shehu chole, vehalach umetzao shemmet — korea umeacho, uchesheyyavo leveto machazir lo chaluko, venoten lo deme kiro. veim lo hodio — hare ze lo yigga bo.
Tanu rabbanan: chole shemmet lo met — en modiin oto shemmet, shemma tittaref dato alav. veen mekarin befanav, umeshattekin et hannashim mippanav.
Umekarin lakkatan mippene ogmat nefesh. vekorin al chamiv veal chamoto, mippene kevod ishto.
Veamar rav pappa, tana beevel rabbati: avel lo yanniach tinok betoch cheko, mippene shemmevio lide sechok, venimtza mitganne al habberiyyot.
Veen mavrin al mittot zekufot. tanu rabbanan: haholech levet haevel, im haya libbo gas bo — yavruhu al mittot kefuyot. veim lav — yavruhu al mittot zekufot.
Rava ittera beh milleta, al legabbeh abba bar marta, dehu abba bar minyome. rava zakef, abba bar marta kafe. amar: kamma let beh data lehay tzureba merabbanan.
Tanu rabbanan: haholech mimmakom lemakom

a: Im yachol lemaet beisko — yemaet, veim lav — yegalgel immahen.
Tanu rabbanan: meematay kofin et hammittot — mishsheyyetze mippetach beto, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer: mishsheyyissatem haggolel.

Maase shemmet rabban gamliel hazzaken, kevan sheyyatza mippetach beto amar lahem rabbi eliezer: kefu mittotechem. vechevan shennistam haggolel, amar lahem rabbi yehoshua: kefu mittotechem. amru lo: kevar kafinu al pi zaken.

Tanu rabbanan: meematay zokfin et hammittot beerev shabbat — min hammincha ulemala. amar rabba bar huna: af al pi chen eno yoshev aleha ad shettechshach. ulemotzae shabbat, af al pi sheen lo leshev ella yom echad — chozer vechofe.

Tanu rabbanan: hakkofe mittato, lo mittato bilvad hu kofe, ella kol mittot sheyyesh lo betoch beto hu kofe. vaafillu yesh lo eser mittot baasara mekomot — kofe et kullan. vaafillu chamishsha achin umet echad — kullan kofin.
Veim hayta mitta hameyuchedet lechelim — en tzarich lichpotah. dargesh — en tzarich lichpoto, ella zokfo. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: dargesh mattir et karbitav vehu nofel meelav.
May dargesh? amar ulla: arsa degadda.
Amar leh rabba: ella meatta gabbe melech, ditnan: kol haam mesubbim al haaretz, vehu mesev al haddargesh. mi ikka midde dead haiddana la otvinneh, vehasheta motvinan leh?
Matkef la rav ashe: may kusheya? midde dehave aachila ushetiyya, dead haiddana la ochlinneh vela ashkinneh, hasheta ochlinneh veashkinneh!

Ella, i kashya — ha kashya, ditnan: dargesh eno tzarich lichpoto ella zokfo. vei arsa degadda, ammay eno tzarich lichpoto? ha tenan: hakkofe mittato, lo mittato bilvad hu kofe, ella kol mittot sheyyesh lo betoch beto kofe!
Umay kashya? midde dehave ammitta hameyuchedet lechelim. detanya: im hayta mitta hameyuchedet lechelim — eno tzarich lichpotah.
Ella, i kashya ha kashya: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: dargesh, mattir karbitav vehu nofel meelav. vei salka datach arsa degadda, may karbitin it leh?
Ki ata ravin amar leh hahu merabbanan, verav tachlifa bar mareva shemeh, dahava shechiach beshuka degildae: may dargesh — arsa detzalla.
Ittemar name, amar rabbi yirmeya: dargesh — serugo mittocho, mitta — serugah al gabbah.
Amar rabbi yaakov bar acha amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. ittemar name, amar rabbi yaakov bar acha amar rabbi assi: mitta shennakliteha yotzin — zokfah vedayyo.
Tanu rabbanan: yashen al gabbe kisse, al gabbe udeyayni gedola, al gabbe karka — lo yatza yede chovato. amar rabbi yochanan: shello kiyyem kefiyyayt hammitta.
Tanu rabbanan: mechabbedin umarbitzin bevet haevel, umedichin kearot vechosot utzelochiyyot vekitoniyyot bevet haevel. veen meviin et hammugemar veet habbesamim levet haevel.
Ini? veha tane bar kappara: en mevarchin lo al hammugemar velo al habbesamim bevet haevel. baroche hu dela mevarchin, ha etoye — mayytinan!
La kashya: ha — bevet haevel, ha — bevet hamenachamin.
Mishna en molichin levet haevel, lo betavla, velo beiskutela, velo bekanon, ella besallim. veen omrim birkat avelim bammoed, aval omdin beshura umenachamin, ufotrin et harabbim.
En mannichin et hammitta barchov, shello leharegil et hahesped. velo shel nashim leolam, mippene hakkavod.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: barishona hayu molichin bevet haevel, ashirim — biklatot shel kesef veshel zahav, vaaniyyim — besalle netzarim shel arava kelufa, vehayu aniyyim mitbayyeyshim. hitkinu sheyyehu hakkol meviin besalle netzarim shel arava kelufa, mippene kevodan shel aniyyim.

Tanu rabbanan: barishona hayu mashkin bevet haevel, ashirim — bizchuchit levana, vaaniyyim — bizchuchit tzevua, vehayu aniyyim mitbayyeyshin. hitkinu sheyyehu hakkol mashkin bizchuchit tzevua, mippene kevodan shel aniyyim.

Barishona hayu megallin pene ashirim umechassin pene aniyyim, mippene shehayu mushecharin penehen mippene vatztzoret, vehayu aniyyim mitbayyeyshin. hitkinu sheyyehu mechassin pene hakkol, mippene kevodan shel aniyyim.
Barishona hayu motziin ashirim bedargesh, vaaniyyim
b: Bichlicha, vehayu aniyyim mitbayyeyshin. hitkinu sheyyehu hakkol motziin bichlicha, mippene kevodan shel aniyyim.
Barishona hayu mannichin et hammugemar tachat chole meayim metim, vehayu chole meayim chayyim mitbayyeyshin. hitkinu sheyyehu mannichin tachat hakkol, mippene kevodan shel chole meayim chayyim.

Barishona hayu matbilin et hakkelim al gabbe niddot metot, vehayu niddot chayyot mitbayyeyshot. hitkinu sheyyehu matbilin al gabbe kol hannashim, mippene kevodan shel niddot chayyot. barishona matbilin al gabbe zavin metim, vehayu zavin chayyim mitbayyeyshin. hitkinu sheyyehu matbilin al gav hakkol, mippene kevodan shel zavin chayyim.

Barishona hayta hotzaat hammet kasha likrovav yoter mimmitato, ad shehayu kerovav mannichin oto uvorchin. ad shebba rabban gamliel venahag kallut rosh beatzmo, veyatza bichle fishtan, venahagu haam acharav latzet bichle fishtan. amar rav pappa: vehaiddana nehug alma afillu betzarda bar zuza.
En mannichin et hammitta barchov. amar rav pappa: en moed bifne talmid chacham, vechol shekken chanukka ufurim.
Vehane mille befanav, aval shello befanav — la. ini?! veha rav kahana safdeh lerav zevid minnehardea befum nahara! amar rav pappe: yom shemua hava, vechivfanav dame.
Amar ulla: hesped al lev, dichtiv: "al shadayim sofdim". tippuach bayyad. killus baregel.
Tanu rabbanan: hamekalles — lo yekalles besandal, ella beminal, mippene hassakkana.
Amar rabbi yochanan: avel, kevan shennina rosho — shuv en menachamin rashshain leshev etzlo.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: hakkol chayyayvin laamod mippene nasi, chutz meavel vechole. veamar rabbi yochanan: lakkol omrim lahem "shevu", chutz meavel vechole.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: avel, yom rishon asur leechol lechem mishshello, middaamar leh rachamana lichezkel: "velechem anashim lo tochel". rabba verav yosef mechallefi seodatayyhu lahadade.
Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: met beir — kol bene hair asurin baasiyyayt melacha.

Rav hamenuna ikkela lederu mata, shema kol shippura deshachva. chaza hanach inashe deka avdi avidta, amar lehu: lehvo hanach inashe beshamta. la shachva ikka bemata?! amaru leh: chavurata ikka bemata. amar lehu: i hachi, sharya lechu.

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hammitkashshe al meto yoter midday, al met acher hu boche. hahi itteta dahavat beshivavuteh derav huna, havo la shiva bene, mit chad minnayyhu, havot ka bachya bitiruta aleh. shelach la rav huna: la taavdi hachi! la ashgecha beh. shelach la: i tzayytat — mutav, vei la — tzevit zevavdta leiddach mit, umitu kullehu. lesof amar la: timush zevavdta lenafshich, umita.

"Al tivku lemet veal tanudu lo". "al tovku lemet" — yoter midday, "veal tanudu lo" — yoter mikkeshiur. ha ketzad? shelosha yamim levechi, veshiva lehesped, usheloshim legihutz uletisporet. mikkan veelach — amar hakkadosh baruch hu: i attem rachmanim bo yoter mimmenni.

"Bechu vacho laholech", amar rav yehuda: laholech belo banim. rabbi yehoshua ben levi la azal leve ivla ella leman deazel bela bene, dichtiv: "bechu vacho laholech ki lo yashuv od veraa et eretz moladto". rav huna amar: ze sheavar avera veshana bah.
Rav huna letameh, deamar rav huna: kevan sheavar adam avera veshana bah — huttera lo. huttera lo salka datach?! ella ema: naaset lo kehetter.

Amar rabbi levi: avel, shelosha yamim harishonim yire et atzmo keillu cherev munnachat lo ben shete yarychotav. mishshelosha ad shiva — keillu munnachat lo kenegdo bekeren zavit, mikkan veelach — keillu overet kenegdo bashshuk.
Velo shel nashim leolam mippene hakkavod. amri nehardae: lo shanu

a: Ella chaya. aval shear nashim — mannichin.
Rabbi elazar amar: afillu shear hannashim, dichtiv: "vattamot sham miryam vattikkaver sham" — samuch lammita kevura.
Veamar rabbi elazar: af miryam binshika meta. atya "sham" "sham" mimmoshe. umippene ma lo neemar bah "al pi Adonai" — mippene sheggenay haddavar leomro.

Amar rabbi amme: lamma nismecha mitat miryam lefarashat para adumma? lomar lach: ma para adumma mechapperet — af mitatan shel tzaddikim mechapperet. amar rabbi elazar: lamma nismecha mitat aharon levigde chehunna? ma bigde chehunna mechapperin — af mitatan shel tzaddikim mechapperet.

Tanu rabbanan: met pitom — zo hi mita chatufa, chala yom echad vamet — zo hi mita dechufa. rabbi chananya ben gamliel omer: zo hi mitat maggefa, shenneemar: "ben adam hinni lokeach mimmecha et machmad enecha bemaggefa", uchetiv: "vaadabber el haam babboker vattamot ishti baarev".
Shene yamim vamet — zo hi mita dechuya. shelosha — geara. arbaa — nezifa. chamishsha — zo hi mitat kol adam.
Amar rabbi chanin, may kera: "hen karvu yamecha lamut". "hen" — chad, "karvu" — tere, "yamecha" — tere, ha chamishsha. "hen" chad, shekken belashon yevani korin leachat "hen".
Met bachamishshim shana — zo hi mitat karet. chamishshim ushetayim shana — zo hi mitato shel shemuel haramati. shishshim — zo hi mita bide shamayim.
Amar mar zutera: may kera — dichtiv: "tavo bechelach ele kever", "bechelach" begimatriyya shittin havu.

Shivim — seva. shemonim — gevurot, dichtiv: "yeme shenotenu vahem shivim shana veim bigvurot shemonim shana". amar rabba: mechamishshim vead shishshim shana — zo hi mitat karet. vehay dela chashev lehu — mishshum kevodo shel shemuel haramati.

Rav yosef ki hava bar shittin, avad lehu yoma tava lerabbanan, amar: nefaki li mikkaret. amar leh abbaye: nehi dinfak leh mar mikkaret dishne, mikkaret deyome mi nafek mar? amar leh: nekot lach miha palga bidach.
Rav huna nach nafsheh pitom, havo ka dayygi rabbanan, tena lehu zuga demehadyayv: lo shanu ella shello higgia ligvurot, aval higgia ligvurot — zo hi mitat neshika.
Amar rava: chayye, bene umezone, la bizchuta talya milleta, ella bemazzala talya milleta. deha rabba verav chisda tarvayyhu rabbanan tzaddike havo, mar metzalle veate mitra umar metzalle veate mitra,
Rav chisda chaya tishin vetarten shenin, rabba chaya arbein. be rav chisda shittin hillule, be rabba shittin tichle.
Be rav chisda semida lechalve vela mitbee, be rabba nahama disare leinashe vela mishtechach.
Veamar rava: hane telat mille beay kamme shemayya, tarte yehavu li, chada la yehavu li: chuchemteh derav huna, veutereh derav chisda, vihavu li. invetanuteh derabba bar rav huna, la yehavu li.

Rav seorim achu derava hava yatev kammeh derava, chazyeh dahava ka menamnem. amar leh: lema leh mar dela letzaaran. amar leh: mar lav shoshvineh hu? amar leh: kevan deimmesar mazzala, la ashgach bi. amar leh: litchaze li mar. itchazi leh. amar leh: hava leh lemar tzaara? amar leh: ki rivda dechusilta.
Rava hava yatev kammeh derav nachman, chazyeh deka menamnem. amar leh: lema leh mar dela letzaaran. amar leh: mar lav adam chashuv hu? amar leh: man chashiv, man sefin, man rekia!
Amar leh: litchaze li mar. itchazi leh. amar leh: hava leh lemar tzaara? amar leh: kemishchal binita mechalava, vei amar li hakkadosh baruch hu zil behahu alma kid havet — la baena, dinfish biatuteh.
Rabbi elazar hava kaachel teruma. itchazi leh, amar leh: teruma ka achelna, velav kodesh ikkeri? chalafa leh shata.
Rav sheshet itchazi leh beshuka, amar leh: beshuka kivhema? ita legabbe beta.

Rav ashe itchazi leh (beshuka), amar leh: itterach li telatin yomin, veahdere[] letalmuday, deamritu: ashre mi shebba lechan vetalmudo beyado. beyom telatin ata. amar leh: may kulle hay? ka dachaka ragleh devar natan, veen malchut nogaat bachavertah afillu kimlo nima.
Rav chisda, la hava yachel leh, dela hava shatek pummeh miggirsa, selek yetev bearza deve rav. peka arza ushetak, vichel leh.

Rabbi chiyyay la hava matze lemikravo leh, yoma chad iddemi leh keanya, ata taref abbava, amar leh: appek li rifta, appiku leh. amar leh: velav ka merachem mar aanya? ahahu gavra ammay la ka merachem mar? galli leh, achvi leh shota denura, amtzi leh nafsheh.
b: Mishna nashim bammoed meannot, aval lo metappechot. rabbi yishmael omer: hassemuchot lammitta metappechot.
Berashe chodashim, bachanukka uvefurim — meannot umetappechot, beze vaze — lo mekonnot. nikbar hammet — lo meannot velo metappechot.
Ezehu innuy — shekkullan onot keachat, kina — sheachat medabberet vechullan onot achareha, shenneemar: "velammedna venotechem nehi veishsha reutah kina".
Aval leatid lavo hu omer "billa hammavet lanetzach umacha Adonai elohim dima meal kol panim vegomer".
Gemara may amaran? amar rav: "vayy leazla, vayy lachavila".
Amar rava, neshe deshachnetziv amaran hachi: "vayy laazla, vayy lachavila". veamar rava, neshe deshachnetziv amran: "gud garma mikkakka venimte mayya leantichi".
Veamar rava, neshe deshachnetziv amran: "atof vechasso ture, devar rame uvar ravreve hu". veamar rava: neshe deshachnetziv amran: "sheyyol itztela demelata levar chorin, dishlimu zevodeh".

Veamar rava, neshe deshachnetziv amran: "rahet venafel ammabara vizufeta yazef". veamar rava, neshe deshachnetziv amran: "achana taggare azzavzage mibbadku". veamar rava, neshe deshachnetziv amran: "mota ki mota umarin chivuleya".

Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: "tov lalechet el bet evel vegomer" ad "vehachay yitten el libbo" — devarim shel mita: deyispod — yispeduneh, deyikbar — yikberuneh, deyiton — yitanuneh, didal — yedalluneh.
Veikka deamri: dela yedal — yedalluneh, dichtiv: "ki tov amor lecha ale henna vegomer".

Tanu rabbanan: keshemmetu banav shel rabbi yishmael nichnesu arbaa zekenim lenachamo, rabbi tarfon, verabbi yose haggelili verabbi elazar ben azarya, verabbi akiva. amar lahem rabbi tarfon: deu shechacham gadol hu uvaki beaggadot, al yikkanes echad mikkem letoch divre chavero. amar rabbi akiva: vaani acharon.
Patach rabbi yishmael veamar: rabbu avonotav, techafuhu avalav, hitriach rabbotav paam rishona usheniyya.

Naana rabbi tarfon veamar: "vaachechem kol bet yisrael yivku et hasserefa". vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma nadav vaavihu shello asu ella mitzva achat, dichtiv: "vayyakrivu bene aharon et haddam elav" — kach, banav shel rabbi yishmael — al achat kamma vechamma.

Naana rabbi yose haggelili veamar: "vesafdu lo chol yisrael vekavru oto", vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma aviyya ben yarovam shello asa ella davar echad tov, dichtiv beh: "yaan nimtza vo davar tov" — kach, banav shel rabbi yishmael — al achat kamma vechamma.

May davar tov? rabbi zera verabbi chinnana bar pappa, chad amar: shebbittel mishmarto veala laregel, vechad amar: shebbittel pardesaot shehoshiv yarovam aviv al hadderachim shello yaalu yisrael laregel.

Naana rabbi elazar ben azarya veamar: "beshalom tamut uvemisrefot avotecha hammelachim harishonim [asher hayu lefanecha ken] yisrefu lach", vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma tzidkiyyahu melech yehuda shello asa ella mitzva achat, sheheela yirmeya min hattit — kach, banav shel rabbi yishmael — al achat kamma vechamma.
Naana rabbi akiva veamar: "bayyom hahu yigdal hammisped birushalam kemispad hadadrimmon [bevikat megiddo]", veamar rav yosef: ilmale targumeh dehay kera, la hava yadana may kaamar.
Beiddana hahu yisge mispeda birushelem kemispeda deachav bar amri diktal yateh hadadrimmon bar tavrimmon, uchemisped deyoshiyya bar amon diktal yateh paro chagira bevikat megiddo.

Vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma achav melech yisrael shello asa ella davar echad tov, dichtiv: "vehammelech haya moomad bammerkava nochach aram" — kach, banav shel rabbi yishmael — al achat kamma vechamma.
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari: ketiv beh betzidkiyyahu "beshalom tamut", uchetiv "veet ene tzidkiyyahu ivver"! amar leh, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: shemmet nevuchadnetztzar beyamav.

Veamar rava lerabba bar mari, ketiv beh beyoshiyyahu: "lachen hinni osifcha al avotecha veneesafta el kivrotecha beshalom", uchetiv: "vayyoru hayyorim lammelech yoshiyyahu", veamar rav yehuda amar rav: sheasauhu kichvara!
Amar leh, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: shello charav bet hammikdash beyamav.
Amar rabbi yochanan: en menachamin rashshain lomar davar ad sheyyiftach avel, shenneemar: "achare chen patach iyyov et pihu", vahadar: "vayyaan elifaz hattemani".
Amar rabbi avahu: minnayin laavel shemmesev barosh — shenneemar: "evachar darkam veeshev rosh veeshkon kemelech baggedud kaasher avelim yenachem".
"Yenachem" — acharine mashma! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: "yinnachem" ketiv.
Mar zutera amar mehacha: "vesar mirzach seruchim". "mirzach" — naase sar lisruchim.
Amar rabbi chama bar chanina: minnayin lechatan shemmesev barosh — shenneemar: "kechatan yechahen peer", ma kohen barosh — af chatan barosh.
Vechohen gufeh menalan? detana deve rabbi yishmael: "vekiddashto", lechol davar shebbikdushsha: liftoach rishon, ulevarech rishon, velittol mana yafa rishon.
Amar rabbi chanina: kasha yetziat neshama min hagguf

a: Ketzippore befi havvevshet. rabbi yochanan amar: kefitture befi vevshet.
Veamar rabbi levi bar chayta: hanniftar min hammet, lo yomar lo "lech leshalom", ella "lech beshalom". hanniftar min hachay, lo yomar lo "lech beshalom", ella "lech leshalom".
Hanniftar min hammet, lo yomar lo "lech leshalom", ella "lech beshalom", shenneemar: "veatta tavo el avotecha beshalom".
Hanniftar min hachay, lo yomar lo "lech beshalom", ella "lech leshalom", shehare david sheamar leavshalom "lech beshalom", halach venitla, yitro sheamar lemoshe "lech leshalom", halach vehitzliach.

Veamar rabbi levi: kol hayyotze mibbet hakkeneset levet hammidrash, umibbet hammidrash levet hakkeneset, zoche umekabbel pene shechina, shenneemar: "yelchu mechayil el chayil yerae el elohim betziyyon".
Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: talmide chachamim en lahem menucha afillu laolam habba, shenneemar: "yelchu mechayil el chayil yerae el elohim betziyyon".
Hadaran alach veellu megallechin uselika la massechet moed katan

Hakkol chayyayvin biriyyay, chutz mecheresh shote vekatan, vetumetum veanderoginos, venashim, vaavadim sheenam meshucherarim, hachigger vehassome, vehachole vehazzaken, umi sheeno yachol laalot beraglav.

Ezehu katan — kol sheeno yachol lirkov al ketefav shel aviv velaalot mirushalayim lehar habbayit, divre bet shammay. uvet hillel omrim: kol sheeno yachol leechoz beyado shel aviv velaalot mirushalayim lehar habbayit, shenneemar: "shalosh regalim".
Bet shammay omrim: hariyyay — shete chesef, vehachagiga — maa kesef. uvet hillel omrim: hariyyay maa kesef, vehachagiga shete chesef.

Gemara "hakkol" leetoye may? leetoye mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin. uleravina deamar mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin patur min hariyyay, "hakkol" leetoye may? leetoye chigger beyom rishon venitpashshet beyom sheni.
Hanicha leman deamar kullan tashlumin ze laze. ella leman deamar kullan tashlumin derishon, "hakkol" leetoye may? leetoye some beachat meenav.

Udela ki hay tanna, detanya: yochanan ben dahavay omer mishshum rabbi yehuda: some beachat meenav patur min hariyyay, shenneemar: "yire", "yerae" — kederech shebba lirot kach ba leraot. ma lirot bishte enav, af leraot bishte enav.

Veibbaet ema: leolam kidamri meikkara, udeka kashya lach ha deravina — la kashya: kan kemishna rishona, kan kemishna acharona. ditnan: mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin — oved et rabbo yom echad veet atzmo yom echad, divre bet hillel.
Amru lahem bet shammay:
b: Tikkantem et rabbo, veet atzmo lo tikkantem. lissa shifcha eno yachol, bat chorin eno yachol.

Livttel — vahalo lo nivra haolam ella lifriyya ureviyya, shenneemar: "lo tohu veraah lashevet yetzarah". ella mippene tikkun haolam, kofin et rabbo veose oto ben chorin, vechotev lo shetar al chatzi damav. vechazru bet hillel lehorot kedivre bet shammay.

Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan kulei. katane cheresh dumeya deshote vekatan: ma shote vekatan — delav bene dea, af cheresh — delav bar dea hu. veka mashma lan keditnan: cheresh sheddibberu chachamim bechol makom, sheeno shomea veeno medabber. ha medabber veeno shomea, shomea veeno medabber — chayyayv.
Tenena leha, detanu rabbanan: hamedabber veeno shomea — zehu cheresh, shomea veeno medabber — zehu illem, ze vaze — hare hen kefikchin lechol divrehem.
Umimmay dimdabber veeno shomea zehu cheresh, shomea veeno medabber zehu illem? dichtiv: "vaani checheresh lo eshma ucheillem lo yiftach piv". veibbaet ema, kidamri inashe: ishtekil milluleh.
Medabber veeno shomea, shomea veeno medabber — chayyayv. vehatanya: medabber veeno shomea, shomea veeno medabber — patur!

Amar ravina, veittema rava: chassore michassera vehachi katane: hakkol chayyayvin biriyyay uvesimcha, chutz mecheresh hamedabber veeno shomea, shomea veeno medabber, sheppatur min hariyyay. veaf al pi sheppatur min hariyyay, chayyayv besimcha. veet sheeno lo shomea velo medabber, veshote vekatan — patur af min hassimcha, hoil ufeturim mikkol mitzvot haamurot battora.
Tanya name hachi: hakkol chayyayvin biriyyay uvesimcha, chutz mecheresh hamedabber veeno shomea, shomea veeno medabber, sheppeturin min hariyyay. veaf al pi sheppatur min hariyyay —

a: Chayyayv besimcha. veet sheeno lo shomea velo medabber, veshote vekatan — peturin af min hassimcha, hoil ufeturin mikkol mitzvot haamurot battora. may shena leinyan reiyya diftiri, umay shena leinyan simcha dimchayyeyvi?
Leinyan reiyya gamar "reiyya" "reiyya" mehakehel, dichtiv: "hakehel et haam haanashim vehannashim vehattaf", uchetiv: "bevo kol yisrael leraot".
Vehatam menalan? dichtiv: "lemaan yishmeu ulemaan yilmedu", vetanya: "lemaan yishmeu" — perat limdabber veeno shomea, "ulemaan yilmedu" — perat leshomea veeno medabber.

Lememra dechi la mishtae la gamar? veha hanhu tere illeme dahavo beshivavuteh derabbi, bene veratte derabbi yochanan ben gudegda, veamri la bene achateh derabbi yochanan, dechol emat dahava ayel rabbi leve midresha havo ayyli veyatvi kammayyhu umenayyeydi bereshayyhu umerachashin sifvotayyhu,
Uvae rabbi rachame alayyhu veittasso, veishtakkach dahavo gemiri hilcheta vesifra vesifre, vechulle talmuda!
Amar mar zutera: keri beh "lemaan yelammedu". rav ashe amar: vadday "lemaan yelammedu" hu, dei salka datach "lemaan yilmedu", vechevan dela mishtae la gamar, vechevan dela shama la gamar,
Hay millemaan yishmeu" nafka! ella vadday "lemaan yelammedu" hu.
Amar rabbi tanchum: cheresh beozno achat patur min hariyya, shenneemar "beoznehem".
Vehay "beoznehem" mibbee leh "beoznehem" dechullehu yisrael! hahu minneged kol yisrael" nafka. i minneged kol yisrael", hava amena: af al gav dela shami — ketav rachamana "beoznehem", vehu deshami.
Hahu millemaan yishmeu" nafka.
Amar rabbi tanchum: chigger beraglo achat — patur min hariyya, shenneemar: "regalim".

Veha "regalim" mibbee leh, perat levaale kabbin! hahu mippeamim" nafka, detanya: "peamim", en "peamim" ella raglayim, vechen hu omer: "tirmesenna ragel ragle ani paame dallim". veomer: "ma yafu feamayich bannealim bat nadiv".

Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "ma yafu feamayich bannealim bat nadiv" — kamma nain raglehen shel yisrael beshaa sheolin laregel. "bat nadiv" — bitto shel avraham avinu shennikra nadiv, shenneemar: "nedive ammim neesafu am elohe avraham". "elohe avraham", velo elohe yitzchak veyaakov? ella: "elohe avraham" — shehaya techilla legerim.

Amar rav kahana, daresh rav natan bar minyome mishshum rabbi tanchum: may dichtiv "vehabbor rek en bo mayim", mimmashma shenneemar "vehabbor rek" — eni yodea sheen bo mayim? ella: mayim en bo, aval nechashim veakrabbim yesh bo.

Tanu rabbanan: maase berabbi yochanan ben beroka verabbi elazar [ben] chisma shehalchu lehakebil pene rabbi yehoshua bifkiin. amar lahem: ma chiddush haya bevet hammidrash hayyom? amru lo: talmidecha anu umemecha anu shotin. amar lahem: af al pi chen, i efshar levet hammidrash belo chiddush.
Shabbat shel mi hayta? shabbat shel rabbi elazar ben azarya hayta. uvamme hayta haggada hayyom? amru lo: befarashat hakehel. uma darash bah?

"Hakehel et haam haanashim vehannashim vehattaf". im anashim baim lilmod, nashim baot lishmoa, taf lamma bain? kede litten sachar limviehen. amar lahem: margalit tova hayta beyadchem, uvikkashtem leabbedah mimmenni?
Veod darash: "et Adonai heemarta hayyom", "vaAdonai heemircha hayyom",

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: attem asituni chativa achat baolam, vaani eese etchem chativa achat baolam. attem asituni chativa achat baolam, dichtiv: "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad", vaani eese etchem chativa achat baolam, shenneemar:
b: "Umi keammecha yisrael goy echad baaretz".

Veaf hu patach vedarash: "divre chachamim kaddarvonot uchemasmerot netuim baale asuppot nittenu meroe echad", lamma nimshelu divre tora ledarvan? lomar lach: ma darvan ze mechavven et happara litlameha lehotzi chayyim leolam — af divre tora mechavvevnin et lomdehen middarche mita ledarche chayyim. i ma darvan ze mittaltel — af divre tora mittaltelin, talmud lomar: "masmerot".

I ma masmer ze chaser velo yater — af divre tora chaserin velo yeterin, talmud lomar: "netuim", ma netia zo para verava — af divre tora parin veravin. "baale asuppot" — ellu talmide chachamim, sheyyoshvin asuppot asuppot veoskin battora. hallalu metammein vehallalu metaharin, hallalu osrin vehallalu mattirin, hallalu poslin vehallalu machshirin,

Shemma yomar adam: heach ani lamed tora meatta — talmud lomar: "kullam nittenu meroe echad". el echad netanan, parnas echad amaran, mippi adon kol hammaasim baruch hu, dichtiv: "vaydabber elohim et kol haddevarim haelle".

Af atta, ase oznecha kaafarkeset, ukene lecha lev mevin lishmoa et divre metammeim veet divre metaharim, et divre osrin veet divre mattirin, et divre foslin veet divre machshirin. ballashon hazze amar lahem: en dor yatom sherabbi elazar ben azarya sharuy betocho.
Velemru leh behedya? mishshum maase shehaya. detanya: maase berabbi yose ben dormaskit shehalach lehakebil pene rabbi (elazar) [eliezer] belod, amar lo: ma chiddush haya bevet hammidrash hayyom?
Amar leh, nimnu vegamru: ammon umoav measserin masar ani bashsheviit.
Amar lo: yose, peshot yadecha vekabbel enecha. pashat yadav vekibbel enav. bacha rabbi elazar veamar: "sod Adonai lireav uverito lehodiam".

Amar lo, lech emor lahem: al tachushu leminyaynchem, kach mekkubbelani merabban yochanan ben zakkay, sheshshama merabbo verabbo merabbo: hilcheta lemoshe missinay, ammon umoav measserin masar ani bashsheviit. ma taam — harebe kerakkim kavshu ole mitzrayim velo kevashum ole bavel,
Mippene shekkedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah velo kiddesha leatid lavo, vehinnichum kede sheyyismechu alehen aniyyim bashsheviit.
Tana: leachar shennityayshsheva dato, amar: yehi ratzon sheyyachzeru ene yose limkoman, vechazru.

Tanu rabbanan: ezehu shote? hayyotze yechidi ballayla, vehallan bevet hakkevarot, vehamekarea et kesuto. ittemar, rav huna amar: ad sheyyehu kullan bevat achat, rabbi yochanan amar: afillu beachat mehen.
Hechi dame? i deaved lehu derech shetut — afillu bachada name, i dela aved lehu derech shetut — afillu kullehu name la.

Leolam deka aved lehu derech shetut, vehallan bevet hakkevarot — emor kede shettishre alav ruach tumea hu deka aved. vehayyotze yechidi ballayla — emor ganderifas achdeh, vehamekarea et kesuto — emor baal machshavot hu, kevan deavdinhu lechullehu, have lehu

a: Kemi shennagach shor chamor vegamal, venaasa muad lakkol. amar rav pappa: i shemia leh lerav huna ha detanya: e zehu shote — ze hameabbed kol ma shennotnim lo, hava hadar beh.
Ibbaya lehu: ki hava hadar beh — mimmekare kesuto hu dahava hadar beh, dedamya leha, o dilma: mikkullehu hava hadar? teku.
Vetumetum veanderoginos kulei. tanu rabbanan: "zechur" lehotzi et hannashim. "zechurecha", lehotzi tumetum veanderoginos. "kol zechurecha", lerabbot et hakketannim.
Amar mar: "zechur", lehotzi et hannashim. ha lema li kera? mikkedi mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hu, vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot!
Itzterich, salka datach amena: nelaf "reiyyay" "reiyyay" mehakehel; ma lehallan nashim chayyayvot, af kan nashim chayyayvot, ka mashma lan.
Amar mar: "zechurecha", lehotzi tumetum veanderoginos. bishlama anderoginos — itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil veit leh tzad zachrut — lichayyayv, ka mashma lan divriyya bifne atzmo hu.
Ella tumetum, sefeka hu — mi itzterich kera lemaote sefeka? amar abbaye: keshebbetzav mibbachutz.

Amar mar: "kol zechurecha", lerabbot et hakketannim. vehatnan: chutz mecheresh shote vekatan! amar abbaye, la kashya: kan bekatan shehiggia lechinnuch, kan bekatan shello higgia lechinnuch. katan shehiggia lechinnuch — derabbanan hi! in hachi name, ukera asmachta bealma.

Veella kera lemay ata? lichdaacherim. ditnan, acherim omrim: hamekammetz, vehametzaref nechoshet, vehabburesi — peturin min hariyyay, mishshum shenneemar: "kol zechurecha", mi sheyyachol laalot im kol zechurecha. yatzu ellu, sheenan reuyin laalot im kol zechurecha.

Nashim vaavadim sheenan meshucherarim vechulei. bishlama nashim kedaamaran, ella avadim menalan? amar rav huna, amar kera: "el pene haadon Adonai" — mi sheen lo ella adon echad, yatza ze sheyyesh lo adon acher.
Ha lema li kera? mikkede kol mitzva shehaishsha chayyevet bah — eved chayyayv bah, kol mitzva sheen haishsha chayyevet bah — en haeved chayyayv bah, degamar "lah" "lah" meishsha!

Amar ravina: lo nitzrecha ella lemi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin. dayka name dekatane: nashim vaavadim sheenan meshucherarin. may sheenan meshucherarin? illema sheenan meshucherarin kelal — litne "avadim" setama! ella lav, sheenan meshucherarin ligmare, umay ninhu — mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin. shema minna.

Vehachigger vehassome vechole vehazzaken. tanu rabbanan: "regalim", perat levaale kabbin! davar acher: "regalim", perat lechigger ulechole ulesome ulezaken ulesheeno yachol laalot beraglav. vesheeno yachol laalot beraglav leetoye may? amar rava: leetoye
b: Mefanneki, dichtiv: "ki tavou leraot panay mi vikkesh zot miyyedchem remos chatzeray".
Tana: hearel vehattame peturin min hariyyay. bishlama tame — dichtiv: "uvata shamma" "vahavetem shamma", kol sheyyeshno bevia — yeshno bahavaa, vechol sheeno bevia — eno bahavaa
Ella arel menalan? ha manni rabbi akiva hi, dimrabbe learel ketame. detanya, rabbi akiva omer: "ish ish", lerabbot et hearel.
Tanu rabbanan: tame patur min hariyyay, dichtiv: "uvata shamma" "vahavetem shamma". kol sheyyeshno bevia — yeshno bahavaa, vechol sheeno bevia — eno bahavaa.

Rabbi yochanan ben dahavay omer mishshum rabbi yehuda: some beachat meenav patur min hariyyay, shenneemar: "yire" "yerae", kederech shebba lirot kach ba leraot. ma ba lirot — bishte enav, af leraot — bishte enav.
Rav huna ki mate lehay kera "yire" "yerae", bache. amar: eved sherabbo metzappe lo liroto yitrachek mimmennu, dichtiv: "ki tavou leraot panay mi vikkesh zot miyyedchem remos chatzeray".
Rav huna ki mate lehay kera, bache: "vezavachta shelamim veachalta sham", eved sherabbo metzappe leechol al shulchano yitrachek mimmennu? dichtiv: "lamma li rov zivchechem yomar Adonai".

Rabbi elazar ki mate lehay kera, bache: "velo yachlu echav laanot oto ki nivhalu mippanav", uma tochecha shel basar vadam kach, tochecha shel hakkadosh baruch hu — al achat kamma vechamma. rabbi elazar ki mate lehay kera, bache: "vayyomer shemuel el shaul lamma hirgaztani lehaalot oti", uma shemuel hatztzaddik haya mityayre min haddin, anu — al achat kamma vechamma!

Shemuel may hi — dichtiv: "vattomer haishsha el shaul elohim raiti olim". "olim" — tere mashma: chad shemuel, veiddach — daazal shemuel veatyeh lemoshe bahadeh. amar leh: dilma chas veshalom ledina mitbeena, kum bahaday, delekka milleta dichtavt beorayyta dela kayyemtay.

Rabbi amme ki mate lehay kera, bache: "yitten beafar pihu ulay yesh tikva", amar: kulle hay veulay"?! rabbi amme ki mate lehay kera, bache: "bakkeshu tzedek bakkeshu anava ulay tissatru beyom af Adonai", amar: kulle hay veulay"?! rabbi assi ki mate lehay kera, bache: "sinu ra veehevu tov vehatztzigu vashshaar mishpat ulay yechenan Adonai [elohe] tzevaot", kulle hay veulay"?!

Rav yosef ki mate lehay kera, bache: "veyesh nispe belo mishpat", amar: mi ikka deazel bela zimneh? in, ki ha derav bivi bar abbaye hava shechiach gabbeh malach hammavet. amar leh lishlucheh: zil ayyti li miryam megaddela seyar nashyay. azal, ayyti leh miryam megaddela dardeke.
Amar leh: ana miryam megaddela sear neshayyay amari lach! amar leh: i hachi, ahdera! amar leh: hoil veayytita — leheve leminyayna! ella hechi yechelt la? havat nekita metara bida vahavat ka shagra

a: Umecharya tannura, shekalta veannachta aggabbe dechara, kedacha veittera mazzala, veayytita.
Amar leh rav bivi bar abbaye: it lechu reshuta lemibad hachi? amar leh, vela ketiv: "veyesh nispe belo mishpat"? amar leh, vehachtiv: "dor holech vedor ba"!

Amar: deraena lehu ana ad demalu lehu ledara, vahadar mashlemna leh leduma. amar leh: sof sof, sheneh may avdat? amar: i ikka tzureba merabbanan demaber bemilleh — mosefna lehu leh, vehavya chillufeh.

Rabbi yochanan ki mate lehay kera, bache: "vattesiteni vo levalleo chinnam". eved sherabbo mesitin lo venisat, takkana yesh lo?! rabbi yochanan ki mate lehay kera, bache: "hen bikdoshav lo yaamin", i bikdoshav lo yaamin — beman yaamin?

Yoma chad hava ka azel beorcha, chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava menakket tene, shavek hanach dimto veshakel hanach dela meto. amar leh: lav hane meallan tefe? amar leh: hane leorcha baenan lehu, hane natran vehane la natran. amar, hayeynu dichtiv: "hen bikdoshav lo yaamin".

Ini? veha hahu talmida dahava beshivavuteh derabbi alekkesanderi ushechev addezutar, vaamar: i bae hay merabbanan, hava chaye. veim ita, dilma mehen bikdoshav lo yaamin" hava? hahu mevaet berabbotav hava.

Rabbi yochanan ki mate lehay kera, bache: "vekaravti alechem lammishpat vehayiti ed memaher bamchashshefim uvamnaafim uvannishbaim lashshaker uveoshke sechar sachir". eved sherabbo mekarvo leduno, umemaher lahaido — takkana yesh lo?!
Amar rabbi yochanan ben zakkay: oy lanu sheshshakal alenu hakkatuv kallot kachamurot.

Amar resh lakish: kol hammatte dino shel ger — keillu matte dino shel mala, shenneemar: "umatte ger", "umatti" ketiv. amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: kol haose davar umitcharet bo — mochalin lo miyyad, shenneemar: "velo yereuni". ha "yereuni" — mochalin lahem miyyad.
Rabbi yochanan ki mate lehay kera, bache: "ki et kol maase haelohim yavi vemishpat al kol nelam". eved sherabbo shokel lo shegagot kizdonot, takkana yesh lo?!
May "al kol nelam"? amar rav: ze hahoreg kinna bifne chavero venimas bah. ushemuel amar: ze harak bifne chavero venimas.

May "im tov veim ra"? amri deve rabbi yannay: ze hannoten tzedaka leani befarhesya. ki ha derabbi yannay chazyeh lehahu gavra deka yahev zuza leani befarhesya, amar leh: mutav dela yehavt leh, mehasheta dihavt leh vechassefteh.
Deve rabbi shela amri, ze hannoten tzedaka leishsha basseter, deka mayyte la lide chashada. rava amar: ze hameshagger leishto basar sheeno mechuttach bearve shabbatot.
Veha rava meshaggar! shane bat rav chisda, dekim leh begavvav divkia.
Rabbi yochanan ki mate lehay kera, bache: "vehaya ki timtzena oto raot rabbot vetzarot". eved sherabbo mamtzi lo raot vetzarot, takkana yesh lo?!
May "raot vetzarot"? amar rav: raot shennaasot tzarot zo lazo — kegon zibbura veakrabba.
Ushemuel amar: ze hammamtzi lo maot leani bishat dochko. amar rava, hayeynu deamri inashe: zuza lealla la shechicha, litlita shechiach.
"Vechara appi vo vayyom hahu vaazavtim vehistarti fanay mehem", amar rav bardela bar tavyome amar rav: kol sheeno behester panim — eno mehem, kol sheeno bivhaya leechol" —
b: Eno mehem. amaru leh rabbanan lerava: mar la behester panim iteh, vela bivhaya leechol" iteh! amar lehu: mi yaditu kamma meshaddarna betzina be shabbur malka? afillu hachi, yehavu beh rabbanan enayyhu. addehachi shaddur deve shabbur malka vegarvuhu. amar: hayeynu detanya, amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: kol makom shennatnu chachamim enehem" — o mita o oni.

"Veanochi haseter astir panay bayyom hahu", amar rava, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: af al pi shehistarti panay mehem — "bachalom adabber bo". rav yosef amar: yado netuya alenu, shenneemar: "uvetzel yadi kissiticha".

Rabbi yehoshua ben chananya hava kae be kesar, achvi leh hahu mina: amma deahderinhu mareh leappeh minneh. achvi leh: yado netuya alenu. amar leh kesar lerabbi yehoshua: may achvi lach? amma deahderinhu mareh leappeh minneh, vaana machvena leh yado netuya alenu.
Amaru leh lehahu mina: may achviyt leh? amma deahderinhu mareh minneh. umay achvi lach? la yadana. amaru: gavra dela yada may machvu leh, bemachog yachve kamme malka?! appekuhu vekatluhu.

Ki ka nicha nafsheh derabbi yehoshua ben chananya, amaru leh rabbanan: may tehve alan mimminae? amar lahem: "avda etza mibbanim nisrecha chochmatam". kevan sheavda etza mibbanim — nisrecha chochmatan shel ummot haolam.
Vei baet ema mehacha: "vayyomer nisa venelecha veelcha lenegdecha".

Rabbi ila hava salek bedarga deve rabba bar shela. shameh leyanoka dahava ka kare: "ki hinne yotzer harim uvore ruach umaggid leadam ma sicho". amar: eved sherabbo maggid lo ma sicho takkana yesh lo?! may "ma sicho"? amar rav: afillu sicha yetera shebben ish leishto maggidim lo leadam bishat mita.
Ini? veha rav kahana hava gane tute pureyeh derav, veshameh desach vetzachak veasa tzerachav. amar: dame pummeh derav keman dela teim leh tavshila. amar leh: kahana, pok! lav orach ara!
La kashya: kan ditzrich leratztzoya, ha dela tzerich leratztzoya.

"Veim lo tishmauha bemistarim tivke nafshi mippene geva", amar rav shemuel bar inya mishshemeh derav: makom yesh lo lehakkadosh baruch hu umistarim shemo. may "mippene geva"? amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak: mippene gaavotan shel yisrael shennittela mehem venittena laggoyim. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: mippene gaavotah shel malchut shamayim.

Umi ikka bechiyya kammeh hakkadosh baruch hu? vehaamar rav pappa: en atzivut lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "hod vehadar lefanav oz vechedva bimkomo"! la kashya: ha bevatte gavvae, ha bevatte varae.

Uvevatte varae la? veha ketiv: "vayyikra adonay Adonai tzevaot bayyom hahu livchi ulemisped ulekorcha velachagor sak"! shane churban bet hammikdash, daafillu malache shalom becho, shenneemar: "hen erellam tzaaku chutza malache shalom mar yivkayun".

"Vedamoa tidma veterad eni dima ki nishba eder Adonai", amar rabbi elazar: shalosh demaot hallalu lamma? achat al mikdash rishon, veachat al mikdash sheni, veachat al yisrael sheggalu mimmekoman. veikka deamri: achat al bittul tora.

Bishlama leman deamar al yisrael sheggalu, hayeynu dichtiv: "ki nishba eder Adonai", ella leman deamar al bittul tora — may "ki nishba eder Adonai"? kevan sheggalu yisrael mimmekoman — en lecha bittul tora gadol mizze.
Tanu rabbanan, shelosha hakkadosh baruch hu boche alehen bechol yom: al sheefshar laasok battora veeno osek, veal shei efshar laasok betora veosek, veal parnas hammitgae al hatztzibbur.
Rabbi hava naket sefer kinot veka kare begavveh, ki meta lehay pesuka "hishlich mishshamayim eretz" — nefal min yedeh, amar: meiggara ram levera ammikta.

Rabbi verabbi chiyyay havo shakli veazli beorcha, ki meto lehahu mata, amri: ikka tzureba merabbanan hacha? nezil venaykbel appeh. amri: ikka tzureba merabbanan hacha, umeor enayim hu. amar leh rabbi chiyyay lerabbi: tiv at, la tezalzel binsiutach. ezil ana veakbel appeh.
Takfeh vaazal bahadeh. ki havo mippatri minneh, amar lehu: attem hikbaltem panim hannirim veenan roin — tizku lehakebil panim haroim veenan nirin. amar leh: ichu hasheta menatan mehay birketa.
Amaru leh: mimman shemia lach? mippirkeh derabbi yaakov shemia li, derabbi yaakov ish kefar chittayyay hava mekabbel appeh derabbeh kol yoma. ki kash, amar leh: la nitztaar mar, dela yachel mar.
Amar leh, mi zutar may dichtiv behu berabbanan: "vichi od lanetzach lo yire hashshachat ki yire chachamim yamutu". uma haroe chachamim bemitatan yichye — bechayyehen al achat kamma vechamma.

Rav idi avu derabbi yaakov bar idi hava regil dahava azel telata yarche beorcha vechad yoma beve rav, vahavo karu leh rabbanan "bar be rav dechad yoma". chalash dateh, kare annafsheh: "sechok lereehu ehye vegomer". amar leh rabbi yochanan: bematuta minnach, la tanesh lehu rabbanan.

Nefak rabbi yochanan leve midresha uderash: "veoti yom yom yidroshun vedaat derachay yechpatzun". vechi bayyom dorshin oto uvallayla en dorshin oto?! ella lomar lach: kol haosek battora afillu yom echad bashshana — maale alav hakkatuv keillu asak kol hashshana kullah.

Vechen bemiddat pureanut, dichtiv: "bemispar hayyamim asher tartem et haaretz". vechi arbaim shana chatu? vahalo arbaim yom chatu! ella lomar lach: kol haover avera afillu yom echad bashshana — maale alav hakkatuv keillu avar kol hashshana kullah.
E zehu katan — kol sheeno yachol lirkov al ketefo shel aviv. matkef la rabbi zera:

a: Ad hacha, man atyeh?
Amar leh abbaye: ad hacha demichayyeyva immeh besimcha — ayytiteh immeh. mikkan veelach, im yachol laalot veleechoz beyado shel aviv mirushalayim lehar habbayit — chayyayv, vei la — patur.
Heshiv rabbi tachat bet hillel: ledivre bet shammay, "vechanna lo alata ki amra leishah ad yiggamel hannaar vahaviotiv" — veha shemuel, deyachol lirkov al ketefo shel aviv hava.
Amar leh avu: uletamaych, tikshe lach, channa gufa mi la michayyeyva besimcha? ella channa, mefannekuta yattirta chazyay beh bishmuel, vechashsha beh bishmuel lechulesha deorcha.
Bae rabbi shimon: katan chigger ledivre bet shammay, vesome ledivre shenehem, mahu?

Hechi dame? illema bechigger sheeno yachol lehitpashshet, vesome sheeno yachol lehitpatteach? hasheta gadol — patur, katan — mibbaya?! la tzericha: bechigger sheyyachol lehitpashshet, vesome sheyyachol lehitpatteach, may?
Amar abbaye: kol hecha degadol michayyayv middeorayyta — katan name mechannechinan leh midderabbanan, kol hecha degadol patur middeorayyta — midderabbanan katan name patur.
Bet shammay omrim: hariyyay shete kesef kulei.

Tanu rabbanan, bet shammay omrim: hariyyay shete kesef, vehachagiga maa kesef. shehariyyay ola kullah laggavoah, ma sheen ken bachagiga, veod: matzinu baatzeret sheribba bahen hakkatuv beolot yoter mibbishlamim.
Uvet hillel omrim: hariyyay maa kesef vachagiga shete chesef. shechagiga yeshnah lifne haddibbur, ma sheen ken biriyyay. veod: matzinu bannesiim sheribba bahen hakkatuv bishlamim yoter mibbeolot.

Uvet hillel, may tama la amri kevet shammay? deka amrat: reiyyay adifa — deola kullah laggavoah, adderabba: chagiga adifa — deit bah shete achilot. udeka amrat: nelaf meatzeret — danin korban yachid mikkorban yachid, veen danin korban yachid mikkorban tzibbur.
Uvet shammay, may tama la amri kevet hillel? dekaamrat: chagiga adifa — deyeshnah lifne haddibbur, reiyyay name yeshnah lifne haddibbur.
Udekaamrat: nelaf minnesiim — danin davar hannoheg ledorot middavar hannoheg ledorot, veen danin davar hannoheg ledorot middavar sheeno noheg ledorot.
Uvet hillel, may shena chagiga deyeshnah lifne haddibbur, dichtiv: "vayyizbechu zevachim shelamim", reiyyay name, hachtiv: "vayyaalu olot"!
Kasavri bet hillel: ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar — olat tamid havay. uvet shammay savri: ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar — olat reiyyay havay.

Amar abbaye: bet shammay, verabbi elazar, verabbi yishmael, kullehu sevira lehu: ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar — olat reiyyay havay. uvet hillel, verabbi akiva, verabbi yose haggelili, kullehu sevira lehu: ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar — olat tamid havay.
Bet shammay — ha daamaran. rabbi yishmael — detanya, rabbi yishmael omer: kelalot neemru besinay,
b: Uferatot beohel moed. verabbi akiva omer: kelalot uferatot neemru besinay, venishnu beohel moed, venishtalleshu bearvot moav. vei salka datach ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar — olat tamid havay,
Mi ikka midde demeikkara la bae hefshet venittuach, ulevassof bae hefshet venittuach?!
Rabbi elazar — detanya: "olat tamid haasuya behar sinay", rabbi elazar omer: maaseha neemru besinay, vehi atzmah lo karva.
Rabbi akiva omer: karva, veshuv lo paska. ella ma ani mekayyem "hazzevachim umincha higgashtem li vammidbar arbaim shana bet yisrael" —
Shivto shel levi shello avdu avoda zara, hen hikrivu otah.
Bet hillel — ha daamaran. rabbi akiva — ha name daamaran. rabbi yose haggelili — detanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: shalosh mitzvot nitztauu yisrael baalotam laregel: reiyyay, vachagiga, vesimcha.
Yesh bariyyay sheen bishtehen; veyesh bachagiga sheen bishtehen; yesh bassimcha sheen bishtehen. yesh bariyyay sheen bishtehen — shehariyyay ola kullah laggavoah, ma sheen ken bishtehen.
Yesh bachagiga ma sheen bishtehen, shechagiga yeshnah lifne haddibbur, ma sheen bishtehen. yesh bassimcha ma sheen bishtehen, shehassimcha noheget baanashim uvenashim, ma sheen bishtehen.

Verabbi yishmael, may tama ka mokmat leh kevet shammay? i salka datach ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar olat tamid havay, mi ikka midde demeikkara la bae hefshet venittuach, ulevassof bae hefshet venittuach?!
Veha rabbi yose haggelili, deamar: ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar — olat tamid havay: meikkara la bae hefshet venittuach, ulevassof bae hefshet venittuach.
Detanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar enah teuna hefshet venittuach, lefi sheen hefshet venittuach ella meohel moed veelach! semi mikkan rabbi yishmael.
Bae rav chisda: hay kera hechi ketiv? "vayyishlach et naare bene yisrael vayyaalu olot" — kevasim, "vayyizbechu zevachim shelamim laAdonai" — "parim". o dilma: idde veidde parim havo.
Lemay nafka minna? mar zutera amar: lefissuk teamim.
Rav acha bereh derava amar: laomer "hare alay ola kaola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar", may? parim havo, o kevasim havo?! teku.
Tenan hatam, ellu devarim sheen lahem shiur:

a: Happea, vehabbikkurim, vehareayon, ugemilut chasadim, vetalmud tora.

Amar rabbi yochanan: kisvurin anu lomar, hareayon en lo shiur — lemala, aval yesh lo shiur — lematta, ad shebba rabbi oshaya berabbi, velimmed: hareayon en lo shiur lo lemala velo lematta. aval chachamim omrim: hariyyay maa kesef, vehachagiga shete chesef.
May hareayon? rabbi yochanan amar: reiyyayt panim baazara, veresh lakish amar: reiyyayt panim bekorban.
Baikkar haregel, kulle alma la peligi diriyyayt panim bekorban. ki peligi bishar yemot haregel: kol hecha daata veayyti — kulle alma la peligi dimkabbelinan minneh, ki peligi daata vela ayyti.
Derabbi yochanan savar: reiyyayt panim baazara, dechol emat deate la tzarich leetoye, resh lakish amar: reiyyayt panim bekorban, dechol emat deate tzarich leetoye.
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: "velo yerau fanay rekam"! amar leh: beikkar haregel.

Etiveh: "velo yerau fanay rekam" — bizvachim. atta omer bizvachim, o eno ella beofot umenachot? vedin hu: neemra chagiga lahedyot, veneemra reiyyay laggavoah. ma chagiga haamura lahedyot — zevachim, af reiyyay haamura laggavoah — zevachim.

Uma hen zevachim — olot. atta omer olot, o eno ella shelamim? vedin hu: neemra chagiga lahedyot, veneemra reiyyay laggavoah. ma chagiga haamura lahedyot — berauy lo, af reiyyay haamura laggavoah — berauy lo.
Vechen bedin: shello yehe shulechancha male, veshulechan rabbecha rekam. amar leh: beikkar haregel.

Etiveh, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: shalosh regalim bashshana nitztauu yisrael laalot baregel: bechag hammatztzot uvechag hashshavuot uvechag hassukkot. veen nirin chatzain, mishshum shenneemar: "kol zechurecha", veen nirin rekanim, mishshum shenneemar: "velo yerau fanay rekam"! amar leh: beikkar haregel.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: "yerae" "yire" — ma ani bechinnam, af attem bechinnam.
Ella: kol hecha daata vela ayyti — dechulle alma la peligi deayel umitchaze venafek, ki peligi daata veayyti.
Rabbi yochanan deamar: reiyyayt panim baazara — reiyyayt panim hu deen lah shiur, ha lekorban — yesh lah shiur. veresh lakish amar: reiyyayt panim — bekorban, daafillu korban name en lo shiur.
Etiveh: "hokar raglecha mibbet reecha". hatam bechattaot vaashamot.
Kidrabbi levi. derabbi levi rame, ketiv: "hokar raglecha mibbet reecha", uchetiv: "avo vetcha veolot"! la kashya: kan bechattaot vaashamot, kan beolot ushelamim.

Tanya name hachi: "hokar raglecha mibbet reecha" — bechattaot vaashamot hakkatuv medabber. atta omer bechattaot vaashamot, o eno ella beolot ushelamim? keshehu omer: "avo vetcha veolot ashallem lecha nedaray" — hare olot ushelamim amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "hokar raglecha mibbet reecha" — bechattaot vaashamot hakkatuv medabber.
Veen nirin chatzain kulei. savar rav yosef lememar: man deit leh asara banim, la lisseku haiddana chamsha ulemachar chamsha.
b: Amar leh abbaye: peshita, he minnayyhu meshavvet lehu poshim, vehe minnayyhu meshavvet lehu zerizin!

Ella kera lemay ata? lichdaacherim. detanya, acherim omrim: hamekammetz, vehametzaref nechoshet, vehabburesi — peturin min hariyyay, shenneemar: "kol zechurecha", mi sheyyachol laalot im kol zechurecha. yatzu ellu, sheen yecholin laalot im kol zechurecha.
Mishna olot bammoed baot min hachullin, vehashshelamim min hammaaser. yom tov harishon shel pesach, bet shammay omrim: min hachullin, uvet hillel omrim: min hammaaser.
Yisrael yotzin yede chovatan bindarim unedavot uvemasar behema. vehakkohanim bechattaot vaashamot uvivchor, uvechaze vashok. aval lo beofot, velo bimnachot.
Gemara ella: olot — bammoed hu devaot min hachullin, ha beyom tov — min hammaaser? ammay, davar shebbechova, hi! vechol davar shebbechova, eno ba ella min hachullin.
Vechi tema: ha ka mashma lan deolot bammoed baot, beyom tov enan baot, keman — kevet shammay?!
Ditnan, bet shammay omrim: meviin shelamim veen somchin alehen, aval lo olot. uvet hillel omrim: meviin shelamim veolot, vesomchin alehen.

Chassore michassera vehachi katane: olot nedarim unedavot — bammoed baot, beyom tov — enan baot. veolat reiyyay baa afillu beyom tov, ucheshehi baa — enah baa ella min hachullin. veshalme simcha bain af min hammaaser. vachagigat yom tov harishon shel pesach, bet shammay omrim: min hachullin, uvet hillel omrim: min hammaaser.

Tanya name hachi: olot, nedarim unedavot — bammoed baot, beyom tov — enan baot. veolat reiyyay baa afillu beyom tov. ucheshehi baa — enah baa ella min hachullin. veshalme simcha bain af min hammaaser. vachagigat yom tov harishon shel pesach, bet shammay omrim: min hachullin, uvet hillel omrim: min hammaaser.
May shena chagigat yom tov harishon shel pesach? amar rav ashe: ha ka mashma lan, chagigat chamishsha asar — in, chagigat arbaa asar — la.

a: Alma kasavar — chagigat arbaa asar lav deorayyta.
Amar mar, bet hillel omrim: min hammaaser. ammay? davar shebbechova hu, vechol davar shebbechova eno ba ella min hachullin? amar ulla: betofel.
Chizkiyya amar, toflin behema livhema, veen toflin maot lemaot. verabbi yochanan amar: toflin maot lemaot, veen toflin behema livhema.

Tanya kevoteh dechizkiyya, tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan. tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan: "missat" — melammed sheadam mevi chovato min hachullin. uminnayin sheim ratza learev mearev — talmud lomar: "kaasher yevarechcha Adonai elohecha".

Tanya kevoteh dechizkiyya: "missat" — melammed sheadam mevi chovato min hachullin, bet shammay omrim: yom rishon min hachullin, mikkan veelach min hammaaser. uvet hillel omrim: achila rishona min hachullin, mikkan veelach min hammaaser.
Ushear kol yemot happesach, adam yotze yede chovato bemaaser behema. beyom tov may tama la?
Amar rav ashe: dilma ate leassore beyom tov, vei efshar leasser beyom tov mishshum sekarta.
May mashma dehay missat lishshana dechullin hu? dichtiv: "vayyasem hammelech achashverosh mas al haaretz".

Yisrael yotzin yede chovatan bindarim unedavot. tanu rabbanan: "vesamachta bechaggecha" — lerabbot kol mine semachot lesimcha. mikkan amru chachamim: yisrael yotzin yede chovatan bindarim unedavot uvemasar behema,
Vehakkohanim bechattat veasham uvivchor, uvechaze vashok. yachol af baofot uvimnachot — talmud lomar: "vesamachta bechaggecha",
b: Mi shechagiga baa mehem, yatzu ellu sheen chagiga baa mehem.
Rav ashe amar: mivvesamachta" nafka. yatzu ellu sheen bahen simcha.

Verav ashe, hay "bechaggecha" may aved leh? hahu, lechidrav daniel bar kattina. deamar rav daniel bar kattina amar rav: minnayin sheen nosin nashim bammoed — shenneemar: "vesamachta bechaggecha", velo beishtecha.
