Mishna mi sheyyesh lo ochlim merubbim unechasim muatim — mevi shelamim merubbim veolot muatot. nechasim merubbim veochlin muatin — mevi olot merubbot ushelamim muatin.
Ze vaze muat — al ze neemar: maa kesef, shete kesef. ze vaze merubbim — al ze neemar: "ish kemattenat yado kevirkat Adonai elohecha asher natan lach".
Gemara shelamim merubbim. mehecha mayyte? ha let leh! amar rav chisda: tofel umevi par gadol. amar leh rav sheshet: hare amru toflin behema livhema!
May kaamar leh? illema hachi kaamar leh: hare amru toflin behema livhema aval lo maot lemaot, velema leh: en toflin maot lemaot! ella hachi amar leh: hare amru af toflin behema livhema.
Keman? dela kechizkiyya udela kerabbi yochanan!
Vechi tema: amorae hu difligi, matneyayta la peligi. veha katane: achila rishona min hachullin.
May achila rishona — shiur deme achila rishona min hachullin.
Amar ulla amar resh lakish: hifrish eser behemot lachagigato, hikriv chamesh beyom tov rishon — chozer umakriv chamesh beyom tov sheni. rabbi yochanan amar: kevan sheppasak, shuv eno makriv.
Amar rabbi abba, vela peligi: kan bistam, kan bimfaresh.
Hay setam hechi dame? illema delekka shehut bayyom likrav, hay dela akrevinhu — delekka shehut bayyom.
Veella delet leh ochlin, hay dela akrevinhu — delet leh ochlin.
La tzericha, deikka shehut bayyom veit leh ochlin, middivkamma la akrevinhu, shema minna shayyore shayyeyrinhu.
Vehachi name mistabbera, dechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: hifrish eser behemot lachagigato, hikriv chamesh beyom tov rishon — chozer umakriv chamesh beyom tov sheni. kashyayn ahadade.
Ella lav shema minna: kan bistam, kan bimfaresh. shema minna.
Ittemar name, amar rav shemen bar abba amar rabbi yochanan:

a: Lo shanu ella shello gamar, aval gamar — chozer umakriv.
May "gamar"? illema gamar korbenotav — may makriv? ella shello gamar hayyom, aval gamar hayyom — chozer umakriv.
Mishna mi shello chag beyom tov harishon shel chag — chogeg et kol haregel veyom tov haacharon shel chag.
Avar haregel velo chag — eno chayyayv beachrayuto, al ze neemar "meuvvavt lo yuchal litkon vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot".
Rabbi shimon ben menasseyay omer: ezehu meuvvavt sheeno yachol lehittaken? ze habba al haerva veholid mimmenna mamzer. im tomar begonev vegozel — yachol hu lehacheziro, vitakken.
Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: en korin meuvvavt ella lemi shehaya metukkan battechilla venitavvevt, vee ze? ze talmid chacham happoresh min hattora.
Gemara menahane mille? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael: neemar "atzeret" bishvii shel pesach, veneemar "atzeret" bishmini shel chag. ma lehallan letashlumin — af kan letashlumin.
Mufene. dei lav mufene, ikka lemifrach: ma lishvii shel pesach shekken eno chaluk mishshellefanav, tomar bishmini shel chag shechaluk mishshellefanav.
Laye ippenoye mufene. mikkede may "atzeret" — atzur baasiyyayt melacha, hachtiv: "lo taase melacha", "atzeret" dichtav rachamana lema li? ella shema minna leafnoye.

Vetanna mayyte la mehacha, detanya: "vechaggotem oto chag laAdonai shivat yamim", yachol yehe chogeg veholech kol shiva — talmud lomar: "oto" — oto atta chogeg, vei atta chogeg kol shiva. im ken lamma neemar "shiva" — letashlumin.

Uminnayin sheim lo chag yom tov harishon shel chag shechogeg veholech et kol haregel veyom tov haacharon — talmud lomar: "bachodesh hashshevii tachoggu oto", i "bachodesh hashshevii", yachol yehe chogeg veholech hachodesh kullo — talmud lomar: "oto" — oto atta chogeg, vei atta chogeg chutza lo.
Umay tashlumin? rabbi yochanan amar: tashlumin larishon, verabbi oshaya amar: tashlumin ze laze.

May benayyhu? amar rabbi zera: chigger beyom rishon venitpashshet beyom sheni ikka benayyhu. rabbi yochanan amar: tashlumin larishon, kevan dela chaze barishon — la chaze bashsheni. verabbi oshaya amar: tashlumin ze laze, af al gav dela chaze barishon — chaze bishne.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi?
Vehaamar chizkiyya: nitma bayyom — mevi, ballayla — eno mevi.
Verabbi yochanan amar: af ballayla name mevi.
Amar rabbi yirmeya: shane tumea, deyesh lah tashlumin befesach sheni.
Matkef la rav pappa: hanicha leman deamar pesach
b: Sheni — tashlumin derishon hu. ella leman deamar sheni regel bifne atzmo hu, may ikka lememar?
Ella amar rav pappa: kasavar rabbi yochanan layla eno mechussar zeman. umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi?
Vehaamar rabbi yochanan: raa achat ballayla ushetayim bayyom — mevi.
Shetayim ballayla veachat bayyom — eno mevi. vei salka datach kasavar rabbi yochanan layla eno mechussar zeman, afillu shetayim ballayla veachat bayyom — mevi!
Ki kaamar rabbi yochanan, ledivre haomer layla mechussar zeman, ledivre haomer — peshita! shetayim bayyom veachat ballayla itztericha leh.
Salka datach amena keatkafta derav shisha bereh derav idi, ka mashma lan kidrav yosef.
Avar haregel velo chag eno chayyayv beachrayuto, veal ze neemar: "meuvvat lo yuchal litkon vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot".
Amar leh bar he he lehillel: hay "lehimmanot", lehimmaloot mibbee leh. ella, ze (shemminnuhu) [shennimnu] chaverav lidvar mitzva, vehu lo nimna immahen.

Tanya name hachi: "meuvvat lo yuchal litkon" — ze shebbittel keriat shema shel shacharit, o keriat shema shel arvit, o shebbittel tefilla shel shacharit o tefilla shel arvit. "vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot" — ze shennimnu chaverav lidvar mitzva vehu lo nimna immahen.

Amar leh bar he he lehillel, may dichtiv: "veshavtem ureitem ben tzaddik lerasha ben oved elohim laasher lo avado", hayeynu "tzaddik" — hayeynu "oved elohim", hayeynu "rasha" — hayeynu "asher lo avado"! amar leh: "avado" velo avado" — tarvayyhu tzaddike gemure ninhu, veeno dome shone pirko mea peamim, leshone pirko mea veechad.
Amar leh: umishshum chad zimna kare leh "lo avado"? amar leh: in, tze ulemad mishshuk shel chamarin: asra parse — bezuza, chad asar parse — bitre zuze.

Amar leh eliyyahu levar he he, veamri la lerabbi elazar: may dichtiv: "hinne tzerafticha velo vechasef becharticha bechur oni" — melammed shechazar hakkadosh baruch hu al kol middot tovot litten leyisrael, velo matza ella aniyyut. amar shemuel veittema rav yosef, hayeynu deamri inashe: yaa anyuta lihudae ki barza summaka lesuseya chivvara.
Rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: e ze hu "meuvvat lo yuchal litkon" — ze habba al haerva veholid mimmenna mamzer vechulei. holid — in, lo holid — la?

Veha tanya, rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: gonev adam — efshar sheyyachazir genevo vitakken, gozel adam — efshar sheyyachazir gezelo vitakken, aval habba al eshet ish vaasarah levalah — nitrad min haolam vehalach lo.
Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: en omer "bakkeru gamal" "bakkeru chazir", ella "bakkeru tale". vee ze — ze talmid chacham shepperash min hattora.

Rabbi yehuda ben lakish amar: kol talmid chacham shepperash min hattora, alav hakkatuv omer: "ketzippor nodedet min kinnah ken ish noded mimmekomo", veomer: "ma matzu avotechem bi avel ki rachaku mealay"!
La kashya: kan baachoto penuya, kan beeshet ish. vei baet ema: ha veha beeshet ish, vela kashya: kan

a: Beones, kan beratzon. veibbaet ema ha veha beones, vela kashya: kan beeshet kohen, kan beeshet yisrael.
"Velayyotze velabba en shalom", amar rav: kevan sheyyotze adam middevar halacha lidvar mikra — shuv en lo shalom.
Ushemuel amar: ze happoresh mittalmud lemishna. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu mittalmud letalmud.
Mishna hetter nedarim — porchin baavir veen lahem al ma sheyyissamechu.

Hilchot shabbat, chagigot vehammeilot — hare hem kahararim hatteluyin bisarah, shehen mikra muat vahalachot merubbot. haddinin vehaavodot hatteharot vehattemaot vaarayot — yesh lahen al ma sheyyissamechu, vehen hen gufe tora.
Gemara tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: yesh lahem al ma sheyyissamechu, shenneemar: "ki yafli" "ki yafli" shete peamim: achat hafelaa leissur, veachat hafelaa lehetter.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: yesh lahem al ma sheyyissamechu, shenneemar: "asher nishbati veappi" — beappi nishbati, vechazarti bi.

Rabbi yitzchak omer: yesh lahem al ma sheyyissamechu, shenneemar: "kol nediv libbo". chananya ben achi rabbi yehoshua omer: yesh lahem al ma sheyyissamechu, shenneemar: "nishbati vaakayyema lishmor mishpete tzidkecha".

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: i havay hatam, amri lehu: didi adifa middidchu — shenneemar: "lo yachel devaro" — hu eno mochel, aval acherim mochalin lo. amar rava: lechullehu it lehu pircha, levar middishmuel delet leh pircha.
Dei midderabbi eliezer — dilma kidrabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi tarfon. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi tarfon: leolam en echad mehem nazir, shello nittena nezirut ella lehafelaa.

I midderabbi yehoshua — dilma hachi kaamar: beappi nishbati — vela hadarna bi. i midderabbi yitzchak — dilma leappoke middishmuel. deamar shemuel: gamar belibbo — tzarich sheyyotzi bisfatav, veha ka mashma lan: deaf al gav delo hotzi bisfatav.

I middachananya ben achi rabbi yehoshua — dilma kerav giddel amar rav. deamar rav giddel amar rav: minnayin shennishbain lekayyem et hammitzva — shenneemar: "nishbati vaakayyema lishmor mishpete tzidkecha".
Ella dishmuel let leh pircha. amar rava, veittema rav nachman bar yitzchak: hayeynu deamri inashe: tava chada pilpalta charifta mimmele tzanna dekare.
Hilchot shabbat. michtav ketivan! la tzericha, lechidrabbi abba. deamar rabbi abba: hachofer gumma beshabbat veen tzarich ella laafarah — patur aleha.
Keman — kerabbi shimon, deamar: melacha sheenah tzericha legufah — patur aleha.
Afillu tema lerabbi yehuda: hatam metakken, hacha mekalkel hu.
May "kahararin hatteluyin bisara"?
b: Melechet machshevet asra tora, umelechet machshevet la ketiva.
Chagigot. michtav ketivan! la tzericha, lichdaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye: mimmay dehay "vechaggotem oto chag laAdonai" — zevicha? dilma "choggu chagga" kaamar rachamana!
Ella meatta, dichtiv "veyachoggu li bammidbar", hachi name dechoggu chagga hu? vechi tema hachi name, vehachtiv: "vayyomar moshe gam atta titten beyadenu zevachim veolot".
Dilma hachi kaamar rachamana: "ichlu ushetu vechoggu chagga kammay"? la salka datach, dichtiv: "velo yalin chelev chaggi ad boker", vei salka datach dechogga hu, tarba lechagga it leh?!
Vedilma hachi kaamar rachamana: chelev habba bizman chag — "lo yalin"!
Ella meatta: habba bizman chag — hu delo yalin, ha dechol hashshana kullah — yalin?! "kol hallayla ad habboker", ketiv!
Dilma i mehahu, hava amena: hahu laase ketav rachamana, hay lelav!
Lelav ketav kera acharina: "velo yalin min habbasar asher tizbach baerev bayyom harishon labboker". vedilma laavor alav bishne lavin vaase!
Ella: atya "midbar" "midbar". ketiv hacha: "veyachoggu li bammidbar", uchetiv hatam: "hazzevachim umincha higgashtem li bammidbar", ma lehallan zevachim — af kan zevachim.
Umay "kahararin hatteluyin bisara" — divre tora middivre kabbala la yalfinan.
Meilot. michtav ketivan! amar rame bar chama: lo nitzrecha ella lichditnan: hashshaliach sheasa shelichuto — baal habbayit maal, lo asa shelichuto — shaliach maal.
Vechi asa shelichuto, ammay maal? vechi ze chote veze mitchayyev? hayeynu kahararin hatteluyin bisara.
Amar rava: umay kusheya? dilma shane meila deyalfa "chet" "chet" mitteruma, ma hatam shelucho shel adam kemoto — af kan shelucho shel adam kemoto?
Ella amar rava: lo nitzrecha ella lechidtanya: nizkar baal habbayit velo nizkar shaliach — shaliach maal. shaliach anya may ka aved? hayeynu kahararin hatteluyin bisara.
Amar rav ashe: may kusheya? dilma midde dehave ammotzi meot hekdesh lechullin!

Ella amar rav ashe: lo nitzrecha ella lichditnan: natal even o kora shel hekdesh — hare ze lo maal, netanah lachavero — hu maal vachavero lo maal. mikkede mishkal shakla, ma li hu uma li chavero? hayeynu kahararin hatteluyin bisara.
Umay kusheya? dilma kedishmuel, deamar shemuel: hacha

a: Begizbar hammesurot lo avne vinyan askinan, dechol hecha demannecha — birshuta dideh mannecha.
Ella missefa: benaah betoch beto — hare ze lo maal ad sheyyadur tachteha beshave peruta. mikkede shannoye shanneyay, ma li dar uma li la dar, hayeynu kahararin hatteluyin bisara?
Umay kusheya? dilma lechidrav. deamar rav: kegon shehinnichah al pi arubba. i dar beh — in, la dar beh — la.
Ella leolam kidrava. udeka kashya lach: midde dehave ammotzi meot hekdesh lechullin, hatam midda yada deikka zuze dehekdesh, ibbaya leh leayyone. hacha mi yada! hayeynu kahararin hatteluyin bisara.

Mikra muat vahalachot merubbot. tana: negaim veohalot, mikra muat vahalachot merubbot. negaim mikra muat? negaim mikra merubbe hu! amar rav pappa, hachi kaamar: negaim — mikra merubbe vahalachot muatot, ohalot — mikra muat vahalachot merubbot.
Umay nafka minna? i mistappeka lach milleta bingaim — ayyen bikrae, vei mistappeka lach milleta beohalot — ayyen bematnitin.
Dinin. michtav ketivan! lo nitzrecha ella lechidrabbi.
Detanya, rabbi omer: "nefesh tachat nafesh" — mamon. atta omer mamon, o eno ella nefesh mammash? neemra netina lematta. veneemra netina lemala. ma lehallan — mamon, af kan — mamon.
Avodot. michtav ketivan! lo nitzrecha ella leholachat haddam. detanya: "vehikrivu", zo kabbalat haddam.
Veappeka rachamana bilshon holacha, dichtiv: "vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol vehiktir hammizbecha", veamar mar: zo holachat evarim lakkevesh.
Lememra deholacha la tappeka mikkelal kabbala.

Teharot. michtav ketivan! lo nitzrecha ella leshiur mikve dela ketiva, detanya: "verachatz et besaro bemayim" — beme mikve. "et kol besaro" — mayim shekkol gufo ole bahen, vechamma hen — amma al amma berum shalosh ammot. veshiaru chachamim me mikve arbaim sea.
Temaot. michtav ketivan! lo nitzrecha ella lechaadasha min hashsheretz, dela ketiva. detanya: "bahem" —
Yachol bechullan, talmud lomar: "mehem". yachol bemiktzatan — talmud lomar: "bahem".
Ha ketzad? ad sheyyaggia bemiktzato shehu kechullo. shiaru chachamim bechaadasha, shekken chomet — techillato bechaadasha. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: kiznav halletaa.
Arayot. michtav ketivan! lo nitzrecha
b: Levitto meanusato, dela ketiva.
Deamar rava, amar li rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi: atya "henna" "henna".
Atya "zimma" "zimma".
Hen hen gufe tora. hane — in, hanach la? ella ema: hen vehen gufe tora.
Hadaran alach hakkol chayyayvin
En dorshin baarayot bishlosha, velo bemaase vereshit bishnayim, velo bammerkava beyachid, ella im ken haya chacham umevin middato.
Kol hammistakkel bearbaa devarim, ratuy lo keillu lo ba laolam: ma lemala, ma lematta, ma lefanim, uma leachor. vechol shello chas al kevod kono, ratuy lo shello ba laolam.
Gemara amrat beresha: velo bammerkava beyachid, vahadar amrat: ella im ken haya chacham umevin middato!
Hachi kaamar: en dorshin baarayot lishlosha, velo bemaase vereshit lishnayim, velo bammerkava layyachid, ella im ken haya chacham umevin middato.
En dorshin baarayot bishlosha. may tama? illema mishshum dichtiv: "ish ish el kol sheer besaro". "ish ish" — tere, "sheer besaro" — chad, veamar rachamana: "lo tikrevu legallot erva".
Ella meatta, dichtiv: "ish ish ki yekallel elohav", "ish ish asher yitten mizzaro lammolech", hachi name?
Ella hanhu — mibbee leh lerabbot et haggoyim, shemmuzeharin al birkat hashshem veal avoda zara keyisrael.
Hay name mibbee leh lerabbot et haggoyim shemmuzeharin al haarayot keyisrael.
Ella, middichtiv: "ushemartem et mishmarti", "ushemartem" — tere, "mishmarti" — chad, veamar rachamana: "levilti asot mechukkot hattoevot".
Ella meatta dichtiv: "ushemartem et hashshabbat", "ushemartem et hammatztzot", "ushemartem et mishmeret hakkodesh", hachi name?
Ella amar rav ashe: may en dorshin baarayot bishlosha — en dorshin besitre arayot bishlosha.

May tama — sevara hu. be tere ki yatvi kamme rabbayyhu, chad shakel vetare bahade rabbeh, veiddach matzle udeneh ligmara. telata, chad shakel vetare bahade rabbeh, vehanach tere shaklu vetaru bahade hadade, vela yadi may kaamar rabbayyhu, veatu lemishre issura baarayot.
I hachi, kol hattora name!
Arayot shane, deamar mar: gazel vaarayot — nafsho [shel adam] mechammedatan umitavva lahem.
I hachi, gazel name? arayot, ben befanav ben shello befanav nefish yitzreh. gazel, befanav — nefish yitzreh, shello befanav — la nefish yitzreh.
"Velo bemaase vereshit bishnayim". mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "ki sheal na leyamim rishonim" — yachid shoel, veen shenayim shoalin.
Yachol yishal adam kodem shennivra haolam, talmud lomar: "lemin hayyom asher bara elohim adam al haaretz".
Yachol lo yishal adam mishsheshet yeme vereshit, talmud lomar: "leyamim rishonim asher hayu lefanecha".

Yachol yishal adam ma lemala uma lematta ma lefanim uma leachor — talmud lomar: "ulemiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim", millemiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim — atta shoel, veen atta shoel ma lemala ma lematta, ma lefanim ma leachor.

a: Hasheta denafka leh millemiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim", "lemin hayyom asher bara elohim adam al haaretz" — lema li?

Kidrabbi elazar. deamar rabbi elazar: adam harishon min haaretz ad larakia, shenneemar: "lemin hayyom asher bara elohim adam al haaretz". vechevan shessarach — hinniach hakkadosh baruch hu yadav alav umiato, shenneemar: "achor vakedem tzartani vattashet alay kappecha".

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: adam harishon, missof haolam vead sofo haya, shenneemar: "lemin hayyom asher bara elohim adam al haaretz ulemiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim", kevan shessarach hinniach hakkadosh baruch hu yado alav umiato, shenneemar: "vattashet alay kappecha".
I hachi, kashu kerae ahadade! idde veidde chad shiura hu.
Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: asara devarim nivreu beyom rishon, veellu hen: shamayim vaaretz, tohu vavohu, or vachoshech, ruach umayim, middat yom umiddat layla.

Shamayim vaaretz — dichtiv: "bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz", tohu vavohu — dichtiv: "vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu", or vachoshech, choshech — dichtiv: "vechoshech al pene tehom", or — dichtiv: "vayyomer elohim yehi or", ruach umayim — dichtiv: "veruach elohim merachefet al pene hammayim", middat yom umiddat layla — dichtiv: "vayhi erev vayhi voker yom echad".

Tana: tohu — kav yarok shemmakkif et kol haolam kullo, shemmimmennu yatza choshech, shenneemar: "yashet choshech sitro sevivotav". vohu — ellu avanim hamefullamot hameshukkaot battehom, shemmehen yotzin mayim, shenneemar: "venata aleha kav tohu veavne vohu".
Veor beyom rishon ibberi? vehachtiv: "vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim", uchetiv: "vayhi erev vayhi voker yom revii"!

Kidrabbi elazar. deamar rabbi elazar: or shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu beyom rishon, adam tzofe bo missof haolam vead sofo. kevan shennistakkel hakkadosh baruch hu bedor hammabbul uvedor happelagga veraa shemmaasehem mekulekalim — amad ugenazo mehen, shenneemar: "veyimmana mershaim oram".
Ulemi genazo — latztzaddikim leatid lavo, shenneemar: "vayyar elohim et haor ki tov", veen "tov" ella tzaddik, shenneemar: "imru tzaddik ki tov".
Kevan sheraa or sheggenazo latztzaddikim samach, shenneemar: "or tzaddikim yismach".

Ketannae: or shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu beyom rishon, adam tzofe umabbit bo missof haolam vead sofo, divre rabbi yaakov. vachachamim omrim: hen hen meorot shennivreu beyom rishon, velo nitlu ad yom revii.
Amar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav: baasara devarim nivra haolam: bechochma uvitvuna uvedaat, uvechoach uvigara uvigvura, betzedek uvemishpat, bechesed uverachamim.

Bechochma uvitvuna — dichtiv: "Adonai bechochma yasad aretz konen shamayim bitvuna". bedaat — dichtiv: "bedato tehomot nivkau". bechoach ugevura, dichtiv: "mechin harim bechocho nezar bigvura". bigara — dichtiv: "ammude shamayim yerofafu veyitmehu miggaarato". betzedek umishpat — dichtiv: "tzedek umishpat mechon kisecha". bechesed verachamim — dichtiv: "zechor rachamecha Adonai vachasadecha ki meolam hemma".

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: beshaa shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu et haolam, haya marchiv veholech kishte fakiyyot shel sheti, ad sheggaar bo hakkadosh baruch hu veheemido, shenneemar: "ammude shamayim yerofafu veyitmehu miggaarato", vehayeynu deamar resh lakish: may dichtiv: "ani el shadday" — ani hu sheamarti laolam day. amar resh lakish: beshaa shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu et hayyam haya marchiv veholech, ad sheggaar bo hakkadosh baruch hu veyibbesho, shenneemar: "goer bayyam vayyabbeshehu vechol hanneharot hecheriv".

Tanu rabbanan, bet shammay omrim: shamayim nivreu techilla veachar kach nivret haaretz, shenneemar: "bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz". uvet hillel omrim: eretz nivret techilla veachar kach shamayim, shenneemar: "beyom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim".

Amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay: ledivrechem, adam bone aliyyay veachar kach bone bayit?! shenneemar: "habbone vashshamayim maalotav vaaguddato al eretz yesadah". amru lahem bet shammay levet hillel: ledivrechem, adam ose sherafraf, veachar kach ose kisse?! shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay". vachachamim omrim: ze vaze keachat nivreu, shenneemar: "af yadi yasda eretz vimini tippecha shamayim kore ani alehem yaamdu yachdav".

Veiddach, may "yachdav"? dela mishtallefi mehadade. kashu kerae ahadade! amar resh lakish: keshennivreu — bara shamayim veachar kach bara haaretz, ucheshennata — nata haaretz veachar kach nata shamayim.
May "shamayim"? amar rabbi yose bar chanina: sheshsham mayim. bematnita tana: esh umayim, melammed shehevian hakkadosh baruch hu uterafan ze baze, veasa mehen rakia.

Shaal rabbi yishmael et rabbi akiva keshehayu mehallechin badderech, amar leh: atta sheshshimmashta et nachum ish gam zo esrim ushetayim shana, shehaya doresh kol "ettin" shebbattora, "et hashshamayim veet haaretz", ma haya doresh bahen? amar lo: illu neemar "shamayim vaaretz", hayiti omer: "shamayim" — shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu. achshav shenneemar: "et hashshamayim veet haaretz", "shamayim" — shamayim mammash, "aretz" — eretz mammash.
b: "Et haaretz" lema li — lehakedim shamayim laaretz. "vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu", mikkedi beshamayim atchel beresha, may shena deka chashev maase eretz? tana deve Rabbi yishmael: mashal lemelech basar vadam sheamar laavadav: hashekimu lefitchi. hishkim umatza nashim vaanashim. lemi meshabbeach — lemi sheen darko lehashekim vehishkim.

Tanya, rabbi yose omer: oy lahem labberiyyot, sheroot, veenan yodot ma root. omdot, veen yodot al ma hen omdot. haaretz al ma omedet — al haammudim, shenneemar: "hammargiz eretz mimmekomah veammudeha yitfallatzun". ammudim, al hammayim — shenneemar: "leroka haaretz al hammayim". mayim, al heharim — shenneemar: "al harim yaamdu mayim". harim, beruach — shenneemar: "ki hinne yotzer harim uvore ruach". ruach, bisara — shenneemar: "ruach seara osa devaro". seara, teluya bizroo shel hakkadosh baruch hu — shenneemar: "umittachat zeroot olam".

Vachachamim omrim: al shenem asar ammudim omedet, shenneemar: "yatztzev gevulot ammim lemispar bene yisrael". veyesh omrim: shiva ammudim, shenneemar: "chatzva ammudeha shiva". rabbi elazar ben shammua omer: al ammud echad, vetzaddik shemo, shenneemar: "vetzaddik yesod olam".
Amar rav yehuda: shene rekiim hen, shenneemar: "hen laAdonai elohecha hashshamayim usheme hashshamayim".

Resh lakish amar: shiva, veellu hen: vilon, rakia, shechakim, zevul, maon, machon, aravot. vilon — eno meshammesh kelum, ella nichnas shacharit veyotze arvit, umechaddesh bechol yom maase vereshit, shenneemar: "hannote chaddok shamayim vayyimtachem kaohel lashavet". rakia — shebbo chamma ulevana kochavim umazzalot kevuin, shenneemar: "vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim". shechakim — shebbo rechayim omdot vetochanot man latztzaddikim, shenneemar: "vaytzav shechakim mimmaal vedalte shamayim patach. vayyamter alehem man leechol vegomer".

Zevul — shebbo yerushalayim uvet hammikdash, umizbeach banuy, umichael hassar haggadol omed umakriv alav korban, shenneemar: "bano vaniti bet zevul lach machon leshivtecha olamim". umenalan deikkeri shamayim, dichtiv: "habbet mishshamayim uree mizzevul kodshecha vetifartecha".
Maon — shebbo kittot shel malache hashsharet, sheomrot shira ballayla vechashot bayyom, mippene chevodan shel yisrael, shenneemar: "yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi".

Amar resh lakish: kol haosek betora ballayla — hakkadosh baruch hu moshech alav chut shel chesed bayyom, shenneemar: "yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo". uma taam "yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo" — mishshum "uvallayla shiro immi". veikka deamri, amar resh lakish: kol haosek battora baolam hazze shehu dome lelayla, hakkadosh baruch hu moshech alav chut shel chesed laolam habba shehu dome leyom, shenneemar: "yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi".

Amar rabbi levi kol happosek middivre tora veosek bedivre sicha — maachilin oto gachale retamim, shenneemar: "hakkotfim malluach ale siach veshoresh retamim lachmam". umenalan deikkeri shamayim — shenneemar: "hashekifa mimmeon kodshecha min hashshamayim".

Mechon — shebbo otzrot shaleg veotzrot barad, vaaliyyayt telalim raim, vaaliyyayt agalim, vechadrah shel sufa [useara], umeara shel kitor. vedaltotehen esh — shenneemar: "yiftach Adonai lecha et otzaro hattov".

Hane birkia itanhu? hane beara itanhu! dichtiv: "halelu et Adonai min haaretz tanninim vechol tehomot esh uvarad sheleg vekitor ruach seara osa devaro"! amar rav yehuda amar rav: david bikkesh alehem rachamim, vehoridan laaretz. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, "lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurecha (bimgurecha) ra". tzaddik atta Adonai, lo yagur bimgurecha ra. umenalan deikkeri "shamayim" — dichtiv: "veatta tishma hashshamayim mechon shivtecha".

Aravot — shebbo tzedek mishpat utzedaka, ginze chayyim veginze shalom veginze veracha, venishmatan shel tzaddikim, veruchot uneshamot sheatid[vot] lehibbarot, vetal sheatid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachayot bo metim. tzedek umishpat — dichtiv: "tzedek umishpat mechon kisecha". tzedaka — dichtiv: "vayyilbash tzedaka kashshiryan". ginze chayyim — dichtiv: "ki immecha mekor chayyim". veginze shalom — dichtiv: "vayyikra lo Adonai shalom". veginze veracha — dichtiv: "yissa veracha meet Adonai".

Nishmatan shel tzaddikim — dichtiv: "vehayta nefesh adoni tzerura bitzror hachayyim et Adonai elohecha". ruchot uneshamot sheatid[vot] lehibbarot — dichtiv: "ki ruach millefanay yaatof uneshamot ani asiti". vetal sheatid hakkadosh baruch hu lehacheyot bo metim — dichtiv: "geshem nedavot tanif elohim nachalatcha venila atta chonantah".

Sham ofannim userafim vechayyot hakkodesh, umalache hashsharet, vechisse hakkavod, melech el chay ram venissa shochen alehem baaravot, shenneemar: "sollu larochev baaravot beyah shemo", umenalan deikkeri "shamayim"? atya "rechiva" "rechiva", ketiv hacha: "sollu larochev baaravot" uchetiv hatam: "rochev shamayim beezrecha".

Vechoshech veanan vaarafel makkifin oto — shenneemar: "yashet choshech sitro sevivotav sukkato cheshchat mayim ave shechakim". umi ikka chashocha kamme shemayya? vehachtiv: "hu gale ammikata umesatterata yada ma vachashocha unehora imme shere"! la kashya: ha

a: Bevatte gavvae, ha bevatte varae. veamar rav acha bar yaakov: od rakia echad yesh lemala merashe hachayyot, dichtiv: "udemut al rashe hachayya rakia keen hakkerach hannora".

Ad kan yesh lecha reshut ledabber, mikkan veelach — en lecha reshut ledabber, shekken katuv besefer ben sira: "bammufela mimmecha al tidrosh, uvamchusse mimmecha al tachkor. bamme shehorsheta hitbonen, en lecha esek bannistarot". tanya, amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay: ma teshuva heshivattu bat kol leoto rasha beshaa sheamar "eele al bomote av eddamme leelyon" — yatzta bat kol veamra lo: rasha ben rasha, ben beno shel nimrod harasha, shehimrid kol haolam kullo alav bemalchuto —

Kamma shenotav shel adam — shivim shana, shenneemar: "yeme shenotenu vahem shivim shana veim bigvurot shemonim shana". vahalo min haaretz ad larakia mahalach chamesh meot shana, veovyo shel rakia mahalach chamesh meot shana, vechen ben kol rakia verakia.

Lemala mehen — chayyot hakkodesh. ragle hachayyot keneged kullam, karsule hachayyot keneged kullan, shoke hachayyot keneged kullan, rechubbe hachayyot keneged kullan, yarche hachayyot keneged kullan, gufe hachayyot keneged kullan, tzavvere hachayyot keneged kullan, rashe hachayyot keneged kullan, karne hachayyot keneged kullan. lemala mehen — kisse kavod. ragle kisse hakkavod keneged kullan, kisse hakkavod keneged kullan, melech el chay vekayyam ram venissa shochen alehem, veatta amarta: "eele al bomote av eddamme leelyon" — "ach el sheol turad el yarkete vor".

Velo bammerkava beyachid. tane rabbi chiyyay: aval mosrin lo rashe ferakim. amar rabbi zera: en mosrin rashe ferakim ella leav bet din, ulechol mi shellibbo doeg bekirbo. ikka deamri, vehu shellibbo doeg bekirbo.

Amar rabbi amme: en mosrin sitre tora ella lemi sheyyesh bo chamishsha devarim: "sar chamishshim, unesu fanim, veyoetz, vachacham charashim, unevon lachash". veamar rabbi amme: en mosrin divre tora legoy, shenneemar: "lo asa chen lechol goy umishpatim bal yedaum".

Amar leh rabbi yochanan lerabbi elazar: ta agmerach bemaase hammerkava, amar leh: la kashshay. ki kash — nach nafsheh derabbi yochanan. amar leh rabbi assi: ta veagmerach bemaase merkava. amar leh: i zechay gemirta merabbi yochanan rabbach.

Rav yosef hava gemir maase hammerkava. save defumebdita havo tanu bemaase vereshit. amaru leh: (ligmor lan) [laygmeran] mar maase merkava. amar lehu: agmerun li maase vereshit. batar deagmeru, amaru leh: laygmeravn mar bemaase merkava! amar lehu: tenena behu "devash vechalav tachat leshonech", devarim hammetukin middevash vechalav — yehu tachat leshonech.

Rabbi avahu amar mehacha: "kevashim lilvushecha", devarim shehen kivshono shel olam — yihyu tachat levushecha. amaru leh: tenenan behu ad "vayyomer elay ben adam". amar lehu: hen hen maase hammerkava.

Metivi: ad hechan maase hammerkava? rabbi omer: ad "vaere" batra, rabbi yitzchak omer: ad "hachashmal". ad "vaere" magmerinan, mikkan veelach masrinan rashe ferakim. ikka deamri: ad "vaere" masrinan rashe ferakim, mikkan veelach, im hu chacham mevin middato — in, i la — la.
Umi darshinan bechashmal? veha hahu yanoka didrash bechashmal, unefaka nura vaachalteh! shane yanoka, delav mate zimneh.

Amar rav yehuda: beram zachur oto haish lattov, vachananya ben chizkiyya shemo. ilmale hu — nignaz sefer yechezkel, shehayu devarav sotrin divre tora. me asa? heelu lo shelosh meot garve shemen, veyashav baaliyyay uderasho.

Tanu rabbanan: maase betinok echad shehaya kore bevet rabbo besefer yechezkel vehaya mevin bechashmal, veyatza esh mechashmal userafattu, uvikshu lignoz sefer yechezkel. amar lahem chananya ben chizkiyya: im ze chacham — hakkol chachamim hen?
May chashmal? amar rav yehuda:
b: Chayyot esh memallelot. bematnita tana: ittim chashot, ittim memallelot. beshaa shehaddibbur yotze mippi hakkadosh baruch hu — chashot, uveshaa sheen haddibbur yotze mippi hakkadosh baruch hu — memallelot.
"Vehachayyot ratzo vashov kemare habbazak". may "ratzo vashov"? amar rav yehuda: keur hayyotze mippi hakkivshan. may "kemare habbazak"? amar rabbi yose bar chanina: keur hayyotze mibben hacharasim.

"Vaere vehinne ruach seara baa min hatztzafon anan gadol veesh mitlakkachat venoga lo saviv umittochah keen hachashmal mittoch haesh". lehechan azal? amar rav yehuda amar rav: shehalach lichbosh et kol haolam kullo tachat nevuchadnetztzar harasha. vechol kach lamma? shello yomru ummot haolam: beyad umma shefala masar hakkadosh baruch hu et banav. amar hakkadosh baruch hu: mi garam li sheehye shammash leovde fesilim — avonotehen shel yisrael hen garmu li.

"Vaere hachayyot vehinne ofan echad baaretz etzel hachayyot", amar rabbi elazar: malach echad shehu omed baaretz, verosho maggia etzel hachayyot. bematnita tana: sandalfon shemo, haggavoah mechavero mahalach chamesh meot shana. veomed achore hammerkava vekosher ketarim lekono. ini? vehachtiv: "baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo", mikkelal dimkomo lekka deyada leh! deamar shem attaga veazel veyatev beresheh.

Amar rava: kol sheraa yechezkel, raa yeshaya. lema yechezkel dome — leven kefar sheraa et hammelech, ulema yeshaya dome — leven kerach sheraa et hammelech. amar resh lakish: may dichtiv: "ashira laAdonai ki gao gaa" — shira lemi shemmitgae al haggeim. deamar mar: melech shebbachayyot — ari, melech shebbabbehemot — shor, melech shebbaofot — nesher, veadam mitgae alehen, vehakkadosh baruch hu mitgae al kullan veal kol haolam kullo.

Katuv echad omer: "udemut penehem pene adam ufene arye el hayyamin learbatam ufene shor mehassemol learbatan vegomer", uchetiv: "vearbaa fanim leechad pene haechad pene hakkeruv ufene hashsheni pene adam vehashshelishi pene arye veharvii pene nasher", veillu shor la ka chashev! amar resh lakish: yechezkel bikkesh alav rachamim, vahafacho lichruv. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam! kategor yease sanegor?

May "keruv"? amar rabbi avahu: keravya, shekken bevavel korin leyanoka ravya. amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: ella meatta, dichtiv: "pene haechad pene hakkeruv ufene hashsheni pene adam vehashshelishi pene arye veharvii pene nasher", hayeynu pene cheruv hayeynu pene adam? appe ravreve veappe zutere.

Katuv echad omer: "shesh kenafayim shesh kenafayim leechad", vechatuv echad omer: "vearbaa fanim leechat vearba kenafayim leachat lahem"? la kashya: kan bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, kan bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym. kivyachol, shennitmaatu kanfe hachayyot.
He minnayyhu immaut? amar rav chananel amar rav: otan sheomrot shira bahen. ketiv hacha: "uvishtayim yeofef vekara ze el ze veamar", uchetiv: "hataif enecha bo veenennu".

Verabbanan amri: otan shemmechassot bahen raglehem, shenneemar: "veraglehem regel yeshara", vei lav deimmaut — mena hava yada? dilma deiggallay vechazya leh. dei la tema hachi, "udemut penehem pene adam", hachi name deimmaut?! ella deiggallay vechazya leh, hacha name — deiggallay vechazya leh.
Hachi hasheta?! bishlama appeh — orach ara legalloye kammeh rabbeh. kareh — lav orach ara legalloye kammeh rabbeh.

Katuv echad omer: "elef alfin yeshammeshunneh veribbo rivvan kadamohi yekumun", vechatuv echad omer: "hayesh mispar ligdudav"! la kashya: kan bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, kan bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym, kivyachol shennitmaata pamalya shel mala.

Tanya, rabbi omer mishshum abba yose ben dosay: "elef alfin yeshammeshunneh" — mispar gedud echad, "veligdudav en mispar". verabbi yirmeya bar abba amar: "elef alfin yeshammeshunneh", linhar dinur, shenneemar: "nehar dinur naged venafek min kodamohi elef alfin yeshammeshunneh veribbo rivvan kadamohi yekumun".

Mehechan nafek? mizzeatan shel chayyot. ulehechan shafech? amar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav: al rosh reshaim begehinnam, shenneemar: "hinne saarat Adonai chema yatza vesaar mitcholel al rosh reshaim yachul". verav acha bar yaakov amar: al asher kummetu, shenneemar: "asher kummetu velo et nahar yutzak yesodam". tanya, amar rabbi shimon hechasid: ellu tesha meot veshivim vearba dorot shekkummetu lehibbarot
